sections.title: SOS Handling
sections.description: This test case checks for SOS and MA handling by Stationary KAVACH
sections.heading: KAVACH_FRS_22: SOS Handling- This test case checks for SOS and MA handling by stationary KAVACH
sections.notes:
(i) The states of MA upon reception of SoS can be as follows
| M1 | No Change |
M2 Rear End Collision SoS and Reduce MA up to Rear End Collision Margin
| M3 | Zero (0) for L2 |
M4 Head On Collision SoS and MA Zero (0) for both locos M5 Rear End Collision SoS when MA not available M6 Head On Collision SoS for both locos when MA not available.
(ii) The States of Status of signal display can be as follows
| S1 | As at Site |
| S2 | Blank |
| S3 | Red |
(iii) The States of brakes can be
| B1 | No Brake |
| B2 | Brake |
(iv) The various conditions that an Onboard KAVACH can based on Communication zone and availability are as follows
| C1 | Zone-Mandatory and Available with station |
C2 Zone-Mandatory and Unavailable with station
| C3 | Zone-non Mandatory |
(v) The various conditions that an Onboard KAVACH can based on Signal Foot Tag read can be as follows
| R1 | Read |
| R2 | Missed and passed 30m |
(vi) The various conditions that an Onboard KAVACH can based on Position Report can be as follows
| P1 | Available |
| P2 | Not Available |
(vii) The type of section occupied by Onboard KAVACH can be as follows
| A1 | Station Section |
| A2 | Absolute Block Section |
| A3 | Automatic Block Section |
| A4 | Virtual Block |
(viii) The result of IXL validations to be done by Stationary KAVACH can result in two states
| I1 | Ok |
| I2 | Not Ok |
(ix) The result of TIN validations to be done by Stationary KAVACH can result following states T1 Same TIN, Onboard KAVACH separated by Signal at ON T2 Same TIN, Onboard KAVACH separated by Signal at OFF & state I2 T3 Different in the Route, Onboard KAVACH separated by Signal at ON, Route not known & state I1 T4 Different in the Route, Onboard KAVACH separated by Signal at ON, Route Ascertained due to enroute Tags & state I1 T5 Different in the Route, Onboard KAVACH separated by Signal at OFF, Route not known & State I2 T6 Different in the Route, Onboard KAVACH separated by Signal at OFF, Route Ascertained due to enroute Tags & state I2 T7 Same TIN, No signal in between two trains

sections.title: Train Speed Processing test case
sections.description: This test case for Testing of Processing of Train Speed by Stationary KAVACH.
sections.notes:
Testing of Processing of Train Speed by Stationary KAVACH. This test is to verify Stationary KAVACH acts properly on the Train Speed information received from Onboard KAVACH.
1. Each PG shall have at least two independent speed output channels.
2. Two PGs shall be fitted on either side of the locomotive on different axles preferably.
3. Each channel of the RH and LH PG is to be compared for determination of speed. If the speed of each input differs by more than 1 Kmph. In case of detection of malfunction of speed determination exceeding speed sense time out, the onboard Kavach shall transit to System Failure Mode. The same shall be noted in event logger and NMS alert is to be generated.
4. Higher of the speeds reported by both PG shall be compared for determination of slip/slide, the same shall be noted in event logger and NMS alert is to be generated. Further, Speed change by more than +/- 5Kmph or 5% of speed whichever is lower shall also be evaluated for determination of slip/slide. In case of detection of slip/slide exceeding slip/slide time out, the onboard Kavach shall transit to SR mode. The same shall be noted in event logger and NMS alert is to be generated.
5. PG sensing interface ports shall be capable of working from 9v to 12v.

cases.title: Check for SB Mode Entry of Onboard when Onboard KAVACH is Powered On and is healthy without any fault and No CAB is active. (FRS-4.1, 4.2)

1. Power on the Onboard KAVACH.
2. KAVACH should be healthy.

cases.expected:
1. The Onboard KAVACH should enter SB Mode.
2. Check for SB mode Indication on DMI.

cases.title: Check for Standstill protection. (FRS 4.5)
cases.input:
1. Power on the Onboard KAVACH.
2. KAVACH should be healthy.
3. Any one CAB should be Active.
4. Try to Move Onboard.
cases.expected:
1. Brakes should get applied and Onboard KAVACH should not allow train Movement.
2. Message shall be displayed in DMI as “Standstill Protection, Brake Applied”.

cases.title: Check for brake test performed in SB mode when no CAB is active.
cases.input:
1. Power on the Onboard KAVACH.
2. KAVACH should be healthy.
3. No CAB should be Active.
cases.expected:
1. No Brake Test should get performed.
2. Check for Test status message on DMI.

cases.title: Check for brake test performed in SB mode when CAB is active. (FRS 19.2,4.3(a)
cases.input:
1. Power on the Onboard KAVACH.
2. KAVACH should be healthy.
3. Any one CAB should be Active.
4. Onboard is in standstill (No brake application required).
cases.expected:
1. After power on the Onboard KAVACH, message “System Self-Test in progress” shall be display in DMI.
2. After completion of self-test, message “System Self-Test Success” shall be display in DMI.
3. Brake Test should get performed and message “Brakes Testing Success”.
4. After that, message “Select Train Config, Press CONFIG Button” shall be display in DMI.
5. Check for Test status on DMI.
6. After that, message “Select Staff Responsible or Shunt Mode” shall be display in DMI.
7. Not require any action on the part of Loco pilot.
8. All vital equipment shall be working normal.
9. Should display context message “Brakes Test – Waiting for MR xxxx (8kg/cm2) ”.
10. Should display context message “Brakes Test – Waiting for BP xxxx (5kg/cm2)”.
11. Should display context message “Brakes Test – NSB Applied, BP – approx. 4.2 kg/cm2” (Where applicable). Check for buzzer working during application of brakes.
12. Should display context message “Brakes Test – FSB Applied, BP – 3.6kg/cm2”. Check for buzzer working during application of brakes.
13. Should display context message “Brakes Test – EB Applied, BP – 0kg/cm2”. Check for buzzer working during application of brakes.
14. Should display context message Brake Test-LEB, BC-1.5 kg.cm2. Check for buzzer working during application of brakes.
15. Should display context message “Waiting for Traction Command”.
16. Should display context message “Brakes Testing Success”.

cases.title: Check for brake test performed in SB mode when Brake Test gets Failed due to EB valve fail.
cases.input:
1. Power on the Onboard KAVACH.
2. KAVACH should be healthy.
3. CAB should be Active.
4. Brake health should Fail by opening the EB valve.
5. Check for mode Transition of Onboard KAVACH.
cases.expected:
1. Onboard KAVACH should retain in SB Mode.
2. Message “Brake Test Fail (NSB, FSB, EB)” shall be display in DMI.
3. Message should display on DMI as “Brake Testing Fail, Press ACK for Retesting”.
4. After acknowledgement brakes shall be re-tested.

cases.title: Check for display of train speed and permitted speed on DMI. (FRS 4.7)

2. KAVACH should be healthy.
3. CAB should be Active.
4. Brake health should be success.
cases.expected:

2. The permitted speed shall be displayed as Zero.

cases.title: Check for Mode transition suggested by Onboard KAVACH when Brake Test is success and cab is Active after configuration. (FRS 4.8 (a))

1. Power on the Onboard KAVACH.
2. KAVACH should be healthy.
3. CAB should be Active.
4. Brake system health Test should be success.
5. Select train configuration.
6. Check for mode of Onboard KAVACH.
cases.expected:
1. ONBOARD KAVACH Mode should be SB only.
2. Message “Brake Testing Success” shall be displayed on DMI.
3. Subsequently ‘Select Staff Responsible or Shunt Mode’ message shall be displayed on DMI.

cases.title: Check for Mode transition of Onboard KAVACH when Brake Test gets Failed due to EB valve fail.
cases.input:
1. Power on the Onboard KAVACH.
2. KAVACH should be healthy.
3. CAB should be Active.
4. Brake system health test should Fail by opening the EB valve.
5. Check for mode Transition of Onboard KAVACH.
cases.expected:
1. Onboard KAVACH should retain in SB Mode.
2. Check for Mode on DMI Display.
3. By pressing SR & CNFM button, check that it shall not be selected.
4. By pressing shunt & CNFM button, check that it shall not be selected.

cases.title: Check for brake test behavior, when KAVACH is isolated in SB mode and CAB is active. (FRS 4.3 (c) and FRS 4.8 (d))
cases.input:
1. Power on the Onboard KAVACH.
2. KAVACH should be healthy.
3. KAVACH shall be isolated manually.
4. Any one CAB should be Active.
5. Onboard is in standstill.
cases.expected:
1. Brake Test should not get performed.
2. KAVACH shall transit to IS mode.
3. Check for Test status on DMI.
4. Isolation counter shall be incremented.

cases.title: Check for brake test performed in SB mode when KAVACH is brought back from Isolation mode and CAB is active. (FRS 4.3 (c) and 4.8 (d))
cases.input:
1. Isolation Switch to be made normal.
2. Onboard is in standstill.
3. Non-Leading input is not Active.
4. Any one CAB should be Active.
5. KAVACH should perform all the brake tests.
6. Train configuration to be selected.
cases.expected:
1. KAVACH shall transit to SB mode.
2. Brake Test should get performed.
3. Train configuration shall be enabled only if brake tests are successful. (FRS 20.1 (b))
4. Check for Test status on DMI.

cases.title: Check for Mode transition from SB to SR when SR is selected on DMI (Power on) when no CAB is active.
cases.input:
1. Power on the Onboard KAVACH.
2. KAVACH should be healthy.
3. CAB should be Active.
4. Brake health should be success.
5. Current mode is SB.
6. Select train configuration and CAB shall be made inactive.
7. No Mode selected and Onboard KAVACH is still in SB mode.
8. Select SR mode.
cases.expected:
1. Onboard KAVACH should not get changed to SR mode.
2. Check for Onboard KAVACH on DMI.

cases.title: Check for Mode transition from SB to SH when SH is selected on DMI (Power on).
cases.input:
1. Power on the Onboard KAVACH.
2. KAVACH should be healthy.
3. CAB should be Active.
4. Brake system health test should be success.
5. Current mode is SB and Onboard is at standstill.
6. No Mode selected and Onboard is still in SB mode.
7. Select train configuration.
8. Select SH mode.
cases.expected:
1. Onboard KAVACH should get changed to SH mode.
2. Check for Onboard KAVACH on DMI.

cases.title: Check for train configuration entry when Onboard KAVACH enters SB mode from Shunt mode. (FRS 20.1 (b))
cases.input:
1. Onboard KAVACH shall be healthy and in shunt mode.
2. Non-Leading input is made in active.
3. Train is at stand still.
4. Any cab input active.
5. Press Shunt and CNFM buttons to enter into SB mode.
6. Onboard KAVACH enters into SB mode.
7. KAVACH should perform all the brake tests.
8. Train configuration to be selected after successful brake test.
cases.expected: Train configuration entry shall be prompted.

cases.title: Check for Mode transition automatically, from SR/ LS/ FS/ FS+OV/ OS+OV/ OS / Post Trip/ PT+OV/ Reverse/ Shunt to SB mode when no cab is occupied. (FRS 4.3 (b) & FRS 4.6).
cases.input:
1. When Onboard is in one of the specified modes in test scenario (SR/ LS/ FS/ FS+OV/ OS/ OS+OV/ Post Trip/ PT+OV/ Reverse/ Shunt mode.
2. Make the CAB inactive.
3. Train is at stand still.

cases.title: To check the manual SOS operation in Onboard KAVACH when it is in SR mode in block section. FRS 5.4 (c)
cases.input:
1. Make sure that no faults are present.
2. Make sure that train is in SR mode through manual selection after booting.
3. Make sure that TIN, direction and absolute location are known to Onboard KAVACH.
4. Now give the manual SOS (by activating the COMMON and SOS simultaneously) in block section.
5. Also check the SOS status in other Onboard which is in 3000m from the SOS generated Onboard KAVACH.
6. Keep the Onboard with speed more than 30kmph.
cases.expected:
1. The SOS should generate and it can be checked on DMI.
2. Source Loco should apply brakes to bring the train to standstill.
3. If there is any other Onboard within 3km and approaching towards the location of SoS (originating source) then the Onboard has to receive the SOS and brakes should apply to bring the train to stand still.
cases.observed: Same Direction (No SOS shall be received ahead Onboard), self-loco should stop. Same Direction (SOS shall be received in rear Onboard), self-loco should stop. Opposite Direction (SoS shall be received in the approaching Onboard)

cases.observed: Same Direction (No SOS shall be received ahead Onboard), self-loco should stop. Same Direction (SOS shall be received in rear Onboard), self-loco should stop. Opposite Direction (Both Onboard shall apply the brake)

cases.title: To check the unusual block stoppage SOS is received in SR mode. (FRS 31.2)
cases.input:
1. Power on the system.
2. Both the Onboard are having position report.
3. Make sure that no faults are present and note down the configured speed limit of SR mode.
4. Make sure that Onboard1 is in SR mode.
5. Now simulate the condition such that the SOS is received from Onboard2 which is stopped in block section (other Onboard is in OS or FS mode with MA>300mts), both Onboard1 and Onboard2 are in same/ opposite direction on different track.
cases.expected:
1. Message “Ack Block Stop, SoS Generates in XX s” should be generated in the originating Onboard.
2. If LP acknowledges train stop, the above message shall get stopped.
3. If MA in Onboard 2 is shortened to less than 300m, the SoS should get cancelled.
4. After 7 seconds (configurable), Onboard 1 shall receive the message “SoS – From Onboard xxxxxx stopped in Block Section”.
5. If LP acknowledges train stop, the above message shall get stopped.
6. The speed of Onboard1 if in rear should reach 0 kmph just before the point of Onboard2.
7. The speed of Onboard1 if in ahead should not be affected.
8. The speed of Onboard1 if in rear should not be affected.
9. The brake shall be applied in Onboard1 and come to zero kmph speed just before the point of Onboard2.
10. After crossing the location of Onboard2, the Onboard1 should maintain the speed to 30kmph till the train passes the originating location of SoS.
11. After crossing the location of Onboard2, the Onboard1 should maintain the speed to 30kmph till the train passes the originating location of SoS.
cases.observed: Onboard 2 Onboard 2 Onboard 2 Onboard1 Onboard 2 Same direction Same direction Opposite direction Opposite direction Same direction Opposite direction

1. After speed come to zero (0), the speed should be limited to 30kmph.
2. The 30 Kmph restriction shall be released after passing 1500m beyond the originating location of SoS message.
3. The 30 Kmph restriction/brakes shall be released when SoS is cancelled by Source.
4. The 30 Kmph restriction/brakes shall be released when SoS message is not received for more than 3 minutes (configurable).

cases.title: Manual SOS is received when Onboard KAVACH is beyond 3000m (configurable) from the location SoS originating source. (FRS 31.4.5, 31.4.7)
cases.input:
1. Make sure that Onboard is in LS mode.
2. Simulate the condition such that the SOS is received from another Onboard KAVACH which is beyond 3000m from the test Onboard KAVACH.
cases.expected: No brakes should apply.

cases.title: To check the MBT test success. (Annexure-B 5.5.2) (Optional)
cases.input:
1. Make sure that Onboard is in LS mode and Onboard is in standstill.
2. Make sure that no EB related faults are present.
3. Now give the command MBT from DMI.
cases.expected:
1. MBT test should be successful.
2. Brake application and brake release time may suitably be updated as perceived during test by Onboard KAVACH. (Optional)

cases.title: To check the MBT test failure. (Annexure-B 5.5.2)
cases.input:
1. Make sure that Onboard is in LS mode and Onboard is in standstill.
2. Make sure that no EB related faults are present.
3. Now give the command MBT from DMI, while brake test is going on, Close the EM Cock, by making the corresponding input low in Onboard simulator.
cases.expected: MBT test should fail and Onboard should transit to SB mode.

cases.title: To check that MBT test is activated when Onboard is on standstill. (Annexure-B 5.5.2) (Optional)
cases.input:
1. Make sure that Onboard is in SR/LS/FS/OS mode.
2. Make sure that no EB related faults are present.
3. Now give the command MBT from DMI.
4. Onboard in standstill.
cases.expected:
1. MBT test should be successful.
2. Brake application and brake release time may suitably be updated by Onboard KAVACH.

cases.title: To check LS mode to NL mode transition when Onboard is in standstill when NL input is active. (Cond. No. 53)
cases.input:
1. Make sure that train is in LS mode.
2. Simulate the condition such that the Onboard is in standstill and leading input is inactive and Non Leading input is active.
cases.expected: System changed to NL mode and it can be verified on DMI.

cases.title: To check LS mode to NL mode transition when Onboard is not in standstill when NL input is active.
cases.input:
1. Make sure that train is in LS mode.
2. Simulate the condition such that the Onboard is not in standstill and leading input is inactive & NL input active.
cases.expected: System should continue in LS mode.

cases.title: To check LS mode to SF mode transition when any critical fault. (Cond. No. 5)
cases.input:
1. Make sure that train is in LS mode.
2. Simulate the condition such that any critical fault occurred.
cases.expected: System should change to SF mode and it can be verified on DMI

cases.title: To check LS mode to IS mode transition in standstill. (Cond. No. 2)
cases.input:
1. Make sure that system is in LS mode.
2. Now do manual isolation of the KAVACH by making the KAVACH ISOLATE input active.
cases.expected:
1. System should be in IS mode and it can be verified on DMI.
2. The 6-digit counter for isolation mode should be increased by one.

cases.title: To check LS mode to IS mode transition when Onboard on movement. (Cond. No. 2)
cases.input:
1. Make sure that system is in LS mode.
2. Now do manual isolation of the KAVACH by making the KAVACH ISOLATE input active.
3. Onboard on movement.
cases.expected: System should not transit to IS mode and it can be verified on DMI.

cases.title:
LS mode to SR mode when track profile is not available up to 3000m (configurable). (FRS 6.5 (d) (i) Cond. No.
23)
cases.input:
1. Power on the system.
2. Make sure that no faults are present and system is in LS mode.
3. Now simulate the condition such that track profile is not available up to 3000m (configurable).
4. when MA > 3000m is received from stationary KAVACH after establishing communication.
cases.expected:
1. System should transit to SR mode and it can be verified on DMI and ACK request should be there.
2. If the Loco pilot does not give the ACK within the configurable time, brakes should apply.
3. After ACK, brakes should be released.

cases.title: To check LS mode to SR mode transition when three consecutive linked RFID tags are missed. (FRS, 5.3(C) 6.5 (d) (ii) Cond. No. 85)
cases.input:
1. Make sure that train is in LS mode.
2. Now simulate the condition such that three consecutive linked RFID tags are missed.
cases.expected:
1. System should transit to SR mode and it can be verified on DMI and ACK request should be there.
2. Direction and absolute location to be erased.
3. Check that message in DMI shall be displayed as “Ack SR mode, Tags Missing”.
4. If the Loco pilot does not give the ACK within the configurable time, brakes should apply.
5. After ACK, brakes should be released.

cases.title:
To check LS mode to SR mode transition when Onboard exits from KAVACH territory area. (FRS 6.5 (d) (iii) Cond. No.
17)
cases.input:
1. Make sure that train is in LS mode.
2. Now simulate the Onboard exits from KAVACH territory area.
cases.expected:
1. System shall remain in LS mode till exit tag. There shall not any spurious braking of this.
2. The exit tag shall be reported to stationary KAVACH through Access request packet. This shall be checked in NMS log.
3. System should transit to SR mode after reading the exit tag.
4. Position report shall not be erased till the complete train has passed the last TIN (Tag). It can be verified on DMI and ACK request should be there.
5. If the Loco Pilot gives the ACK within the configurable time, brakes should not apply.

cases.title:
To check LS mode to SR mode transition when train traffic direction is unknown. (FRS 6.5 (d) (iv) Cond. No.
30)
cases.input:
1. Make sure that train is in LS mode and movement in nominal direction.
2. Now simulate the RFID tag which is programmed in reverse direction absolute location.
3. Now simulate the condition such that the train traffic direction is unknown.
cases.expected:
1. System should transit to SR mode and it can be verified on DMI.
2. Check that message displayed in DMI as “Ack SR mode, Direction Unknown”.
3. If the Loco pilot gives the ACK within the configurable time, brakes should not apply.

cases.title: To check LS mode to OS mode transition. (FRS 6.5 (a) Cond. No 90)
cases.input:
1. Make sure that train is in LS mode.
2. Onboard is in communication mandatory area.
3. Simulate such that valid radio packets are received.
4. OS MA is sent by Stationary KAVACH.
cases.expected: Onboard KAVACH shall transit to OS mode.

cases.title: To check LS mode to RV mode transition when Onboard is in standstill. (FRS 6.5 (b), Condi. 58)
cases.input:
1. Make sure that train is in LS mode.
2. Simulate the condition such that the Onboard is in standstill, reverser handle is changed to reverse position and Loco Pilot requests the RV mode.
cases.expected: System should be in RV mode and it can be verified on DMI.

cases.title: To check LS mode to RV mode transition when Onboard is not in standstill. (FRS 6.5 (b), Condi. 58)
cases.input:
1. Make sure that train is in LS mode.
2. Simulate the condition such that the Onboard is not in standstill.
3. Loco Pilot requests the RV mode.
cases.expected: System should be in LS mode and it can be verified on DMI.

cases.title: To check LS mode to SH mode transition when Onboard is in standstill. (FRS 6.5 (c), Condi. 56)
cases.input:
1. Make sure that train is in LS mode.
2. Simulate the condition such that the Onboard is in standstill and Loco Pilot requests the SH mode.
cases.expected: System should be in SH mode and it can be verified on DMI.

cases.title: To check LS mode to SH mode transition when Onboard is not in standstill. (FRS 6.5 (c), Condi. 56)
cases.input:
1. Make sure that train is in LS mode.
2. Simulate the condition such that the Onboard is not in standstill and Loco Pilot requests the SH mode.
cases.expected: System should be in LS mode and it can be verified on DMI.

cases.title: To check LS mode to SB mode transition when no cab is occupied. (FRS 4.8(B), Condi. 7)
cases.input:
1. Make sure that train is in LS mode.
2. Train is running;
3. Make sure that no cab is active.
4. Train shall stop after some time.
cases.expected: System should transit to SB mode after the train comes to standstill and it can be verified on DMI.

cases.title: To check LS mode to SB mode transition, if EM cock is Closed. (Condi. 7)
cases.input:
1. Make sure that no faults are present.
2. Make sure that train is in LS mode.
3. Now make EM cock is closed.
cases.expected: System should enter into SB mode; it can be verified on DMI.

cases.title: To check LS mode to SB mode transition, EM cock health of EB channel failed. (Safety Requirement)
cases.input:
1. Keep the Onboard is in LS mode.
2. Now make health of EB channel failed by removing of wires of EM cock.
cases.expected: System should enter into SF mode; it can be verified on DMI.

cases.title: To verify unusual stoppage of trains by transmitting the SOS in block section. (FRS 31.2.4)
cases.input:
1. Make sure that train is in LS mode.
2. Simulate a condition such that there is another train equipped with functional KAVACH within the region 3km, in block section on different TINs.
3. Simulate the condition that other train is stopped in block section and Loco Pilot has not responded within 7 Sec.
4. Check for 25 Kmph, 60 Kmph and more than 100 Kmph.
cases.expected:
1. SOS should get generated from the Onboard KAVACH unit of stopped train. The location of the train is target.
2. Onboard KAVACH units which receive the SOS and are moving towards the target within 3km from the concerned should apply brakes and bring the loco to standstill before reaching target.
3. After the loco speed is reduced to zero, the speed should be limited to 30kmph up to after train length and including Source train length.
4. Brake should not be applied to the train moving away from the target.

cases.title: To verify unusual stoppage of trains by transmitting the SOS in block section. (in condition of adjustment tag as per below figure) (FRS 31.2.4)
cases.input:
1. Make sure that train is in LS mode.
2. Adjustment tag placed after the loco 1 for adjustment of 2 kilometers.
3. Simulate a condition such that there is another train equipped with functional KAVACH within the region 3km, in block section on different TINs.
4. Simulate the condition that other train is stopped in block section and Loco Pilot has not responded within 7 Sec.
5. Check for 25 Kmph, 60 Kmph and more than 100 Kmph.
cases.expected:
1. SOS should get generated from the Onboard KAVACH unit of stopped train. The location of the train is target.
2. Onboard KAVACH units which receive the SOS and are moving towards the target within 3km from the concerned should apply brakes and bring the loco to standstill before reaching target.
3. After the loco speed is reduced to zero, the speed should be limited to 30kmph up to after train length and including Source train length.
4. Brake should not be applied to the train moving away from the target.

cases.title: To verify not generation of SOS in the case of unusual stoppage of train in block section and Loco Pilot given ACK within the configurable time before generating the SOS. (FRS 31.2.3)
cases.input:
1. Make sure that train is in LS mode.
2. Simulate the condition that train is stopped in block section and Loco Pilot has responded within the 7 Sec (Configurable).
cases.expected: SOS should not generate.

cases.title: Transmitting the manual SOS by the Onboard. (FRS 31.4.5)
cases.input:
1. Make sure that train is in LS mode.
2. Keep one Onboard in main line (Onboard1) and another Onboard in loop line (Onboard2).
3. Simulate Onboard-1 to be in rear of Onboard2.
4. Now give manual SOS from Onboard2.
cases.expected:
1. SOS message should receive in Onboard1, the message “SOS - From Loco XXXXXX” should show.
2. Brake should apply in Onboard-1 till it comes to zero kmph.
3. From zero speed, the Onboard1 should be allowed to move at 30 kmph, until it moves 1500m beyond the SOS originating location.

cases.title: Check that brakes are released when SOS is received and radio packets are not available from next for more than 180 seconds (configurable) after receiving the manual SOS from Registered station.
cases.input:
1. Make sure that train is in FS/OS mode.
2. Simulate the condition that a SOS is generated from station.
3. After receiving SOS at Onboard, remove RX connection of both radios in Onboard.
4. Onboard transits to SR/LS mode.
cases.expected: Brakes should be released after stand still and SoS is cancelled in loco after configurable time (180 seconds).

cases.title: Check that brakes are released when SOS is received and radio packets are not available from next cycle for more than 180 seconds (configurable) after receiving the manual SOS. It is from stationary KAVACH in which, not registered.
cases.input:
1. Make sure that train is in FS/OS mode.
2. Simulate the condition that a SOS is generated from station.
3. After receiving SOS at Onboard, remove RX connection of both radios in Onboard.
cases.expected: Brakes should be released after stand still and SoS is cancelled in loco after configurable time (180 seconds).

cases.title: To check the inhibition of reverse movement operation in LS mode and driving from CAB1. (FRS 13.8)
cases.input:
1. Power on the system.
2. Make sure that no faults are present and driving CAB is CAB1.
3. Make sure that train is in LS mode.
4. Now keep the reverser handle in reverse position and keep the Onboard running.
cases.expected: Brakes should apply and traction should be cut off.

cases.title: To check the inhibition of reverse movement operation in LS mode and driving from CAB2. (FRS 13.8)
cases.input:
1. Power on the system.
2. Make sure that no faults are present and driving CAB is CAB2.
3. Make sure that train is in LS mode.
4. Now keep the reverser handle in Reverse position and keep the Onboard in running.
cases.expected: Brakes should apply and traction should be cut off.

cases.title: To check the LC gate operation in LS mode when LC gate tag is read in main line and the train is not standstill. (FRS- 32)
cases.input:
1. Power on the system.
2. Make sure that no faults are present.
3. Make sure that train is in LS mode.
4. Simulate the condition such that the LC gate tag is swiped.
cases.expected: A message should display on DMI, auto whistling should be ON, verify the LC gate related parameters. Auto whistling should be on until Loco Pilot gives ACK or LC gate is crossed.

cases.title: To check the LC gate operation in LS mode when LC gate tag is not read, but Track profile information is there throughout the main line and the train is not standstill. (FRS- 32)
cases.input:
1. Power on the system.
2. Make sure that no faults are present.
3. Make sure that train is in LS mode.
4. Simulate the condition such that the LC gate tag is missed.
cases.expected:
1. A message should have displayed on DMI, auto whistling should be ON, verify the LC gate related parameters.
2. Auto whistling should be on until Loco Pilot gives ACK or LC gate is crossed.

cases.title: To check the LC gate operation in LS mode when LC gate tag is read in loop line and the train is not standstill. (FRS- 32)
cases.input:
1. Power on the system.
2. Make sure that no faults are present.
3. Make sure that train is in LS mode.
4. Simulate the condition such that the LC gate tag is received.
cases.expected:
1. A message should be displayed on DMI, auto whistling should be ON, verify the LC gate related parameters.
2. Auto whistling should be on until Loco Pilot gives ACK or LC gate is crossed.
3. If the Onboard is come to standstill, then the LC gate message should not show and Auto whistling should be OFF until the Onboard is in standstill.

cases.title: To check the LC gate operation in LS mode when LC gate tag is not read, but track profile information is there throughout the loop line and the train is not standstill. (FRS- 32)
cases.input:
1. Power on the system.
2. Make sure that no faults are present.
3. Make sure that train is in LS mode.
4. Simulate the condition such that the LC gate tag is missed and the MA is more than the LC gate distance.
cases.expected:
1. A message should be displayed on DMI, auto whistling should be ON, verify the LC gate related parameters.
2. Auto whistling should be on until Loco Pilot gives ACK or LC gate is crossed.

cases.title: To check the LC gate operation in LS mode. LC gate tag is read. when train is standstill. (FRS- 32)
cases.input:
1. Make sure that train is in LS mode.
2. Simulate the condition such that the LC gate tag is received.
3. Confirm that LC gate information is processed by system by verifying the LC gate distance on DMI and buzzer operation is working.
cases.expected:
1. A message should be display on DMI, auto whistling should be ON, verify the LC gate related parameters.
2. Auto whistling should be on until Loco Pilot gives ACK or LC gate is crossed or Onboard comes to standstill.
3. When the Onboard moves, Auto whistling shall start again till the front end of train touches the LC gate location.

cases.title: To check the LC gate operation in LS mode & LC gate tag is not read (LC Gate info available in track profile packet). when train is standstill. (FRS- 32)
cases.input:
1. Make sure that train is in LS mode.
2. Simulate the condition such that the LC gate tag is not read.
cases.expected: LC gate information should not show on DMI when train is in standstill. There shall not be any auto whistling when train is standstill.

cases.title: De registration of Onboard when there is no communication for more than de- registration time out. (120 second for Absolute Section).
cases.input: When Onboard is in LS mode make a movement and there is no communication for more than deregistration time out.
cases.expected: Onboard should get De-registered when there is no communication for more than 120 second in absolute block section or station section.

cases.title: De registration of Onboard when there is no communication for more than de- registration time out. (30 second for Automatic Section).
cases.input: When Onboard is in LS mode make a movement and there is no communication for more than deregistration time out.
cases.expected: Onboard should get De-registered when there is no communication for more than 30 second in Automatic block section.

cases.title: Check for no Mode transition from LS mode when train configuration is changed during standstill. (FRS 22.1)
cases.input:
1. Ensure that Onboard is in LS mode.
2. Onboard is at stand still.
3. Make the CAB active.
4. Change the train configuration.
cases.expected:
1. Onboard KAVACH shall conduct brake tests.
2. On successful brake tests Onboard KAVACH should remain in LS mode.

cases.title: Check for LP acknowledgement when Onboard Kavach transits from FS to LS and then to OS before LP acknowledgment.
cases.input:
1. Ensure Onboard Kavach is in FS mode with track profile greater than 3000m.
2. Simulate radio communication fail at Stationary Kavach side and ensure that Onboard Kavach enters into LS mode.
3. No acknowledgement to be done by Loco Pilot.
4. Restore the communication within the deregistration time out and Onboard Kavach shall transit to OS mode.
cases.expected:
1. The following context message shall be displayed on DMI “Ack LS mode, Station Radio Comm Fail”.
2. The following context message shall be displayed on DMI “Ack OS Mode”.
3. Brakes shall be applied if no acknowledgement is received within LP acknowledgement timeout (7 second).

cases.title: To check the FS mode transition in Nominal Direction. (FRS 7.1 (a to d))
cases.input:
1. Make sure that KAVACH is in SR mode.
2. Now simulate the condition such that the Onboard is passed two consecutive RFID Tags such that the absolute distance is incrementing.
3. Make sure that no faults are present in the system.
(i) Track profile Available (Including Traffic Direction) up to 3000m or Movement Authority, whichever is less.
(ii) Valid Radio Packets are receiving in communication mandatory area.
(iii) Movement Authority is valid.
4. Check that Onboard transits to OS mode.
cases.expected:
1. Onboard KAVACH should enter into FS mode (after getting Valid MA & track profile up to 3000m (configurable) or movement authority which ever less, Valid radio packets are available, one stop signal should be passed in off condition.
2. On DMI, FS mode should be shown, absolute location value should be in incremented and it can be verified on DMI.
3. If the absolute location value is incremented then it should be nominal-N.
4. Onboard KAVACH should transmit the data (including location) to the station for every 2sec.
5. Check the parameters train speed, permitted speed, target distance, target speed to the Loco Pilot if any on DMI.
6. The Onboard KAVACH should receive the data from station for every 2sec. Check the radio packet data and normal tag data in data logger.

cases.title: To check the FS mode transition in Reverse Direction. (FRS 7.1 (a to d))
cases.input:
1. KAVACH is in OS mode.
2. Now simulate the condition such that the Onboard is passed two consecutive RFID Tags such that the absolute distance is decrementing.
3. Make sure that no faults are present in the system.
(i) Track profile Available (Including Traffic Direction) up to 3000m or Movement Authority, whichever is less.
(ii) Valid Radio Packets are receiving in communication mandatory area.
(iii) Movement Authority is valid.
4. Check the traffic direction.
cases.expected:
1. Onboard KAVACH should be enter into FS mode (after getting Valid MA & track profile up to 3000m (configurable) or movement authority which ever less, valid radio packets are available, one stop signal should be passed in off condition.
2. On DMI, FS mode should be shown, absolute location value should be in decremented and it can be verified on DMI.
3. If the absolute location value is decremented then it should be Reverse-R.
4. Onboard KAVACH should transmit the data (including location) to the station for every 2sec.
5. Check the parameters train speed, permitted speed, target distance, target speed to the Loco Pilot if any on DMI.
6. The Onboard KAVACH should receive the data from station for every 2sec Check the radio packet data and normal tag data in data logger.

cases.title: Check that SR mode manual selection is not feasible from FS mode.
cases.input:
1. Keep the Onboard in FS mode.
2. Now press the SR and CNFM buttons on DMI.
cases.expected: Onboard KAVACH shall not transit from the existing mode.

cases.title: To check the FS mode transition when track profile is not available from the REAR end of the train. (FRS 7.2)
cases.input:
1. Keep the Onboard OS mode.
2. Extend FS MA.
3. Extend track profile from the FRONT end of the train.
cases.expected: Onboard shall not transit FS mode.

cases.title: To check the FS mode transition when track profile is available from the REAR end of the train. (FRS 7.2)
cases.input:
1. Keep the Onboard OS mode.
2. Extend FS MA.
3. Extend track profile from the REAR end of the train.
cases.expected: Onboard shall continue in FS mode after passing the approaching stop signal.

cases.title: Check for supervision of train movement against dynamic speed profile in FS mode and Nominal direction. (FRS 7.3)
cases.input:
1. Keep the Onboard in FS mode.
2. Let the max train speed be 160 Kmph.
3. Let the max permissible speed of the track be 130 Kmph.
4. Let the PSR of 80 Kmph be programmed for a distance of 1000m and a TSR of 60 Kmph be programmed within the PSR for a distance of 200m.
5. Let the max permissible speed of the track be 160 Kmph.
6. Let of absolute location be X and direction is Nominal.
| TSR start | TSR end | TSR speed |
| X-200 | X | 30 |
| X-100 | X+100 | 40 |
| X+100 | X+200 | 75 |
| X+800 | X+1000 | 40 |
| X+900 | X+1100 | 30 |
| X+1000 | X+1200 | 60 |
cases.expected:
1. When the max permissible speed of the track is 130 Kmph, the Onboard KAVACH shall show the permitted speed as 130 Kmph.
2. On the approach of 80 Kmph PSR, Onboard KAVACH shall supervise against this, till the complete train is passed.
3. On the approach of 60 Kmph TSR, Onboard KAVACH shall supervise against this, till the complete train is passed.
4. When the max permissible speed of the track is 160 Kmph, the Onboard KAVACH shall show the permitted speed as 160 Kmph.
5. Absolute location be X and direction

cases.title: Check for supervision of train movement against dynamic speed profile in FS mode and Reverse direction. (FRS 7.3)
cases.input:
1. Keep the Onboard in FS mode.
2. Let the max train speed be 160 Kmph.
3. Let the max permissible speed of the track 130 Kmph.
4. Let the PSR of 80 Kmph be programmed for a distance of 1000m and a TSR of 60 Kmph be programmed within the PSR for a distance of 200m.
5. Let the max permissible speed of the track 160 Kmph.
6. Let of absolute location be X and direction is Reverse

| X-800 | X-1000 | 40 |
| X-900 | X-1100 | 30 |

cases.expected:
1. When the max permissible speed of the track is 130 Kmph, the Onboard KAVACH shall show the permitted speed as 130 Kmph.
2. On the approach of 80 Kmph PSR, Onboard KAVACH shall supervise against this, till the complete train is passed.
3. On the approach of 60 Kmph TSR, Onboard KAVACH shall supervise against this, till the complete train is passed.
4. When the max permissible speed of the track is 160 Kmph, the Onboard KAVACH shall show the permitted speed as 160 Kmph.
5. Absolute location be X and direction

| X-900 | X-1100 | 30 |
| X-1000 | X-1200 | 60 |

cases.title: Check for display for train speed, permitted speed, signal aspect, target type and target distance. (FRS 7.4)
cases.input:
1. Make sure that Onboard KAVACH is in FS mode.
2. Note down the configured speed limit of the train.
3. Now keep the train in running with the speed up to the configured value.
cases.expected:
1. Train has to run with the speed without any brake application.
2. The permitted speed limit on DMI should be the lower of LE/ train maximum speed.
3. The train speed shall be displayed.
4. The Signal aspect shall be displayed.
5. Create a target scenario like TSR/PSR. The target distance and speed shall be displayed.

cases.title: Check for Mode transition to SB when CAB is changed in case of dual CAB or driving position is changed in case of single cab. (FRS 21.1 (d) and (e))
cases.input:
1. Keep the Onboard in FS mode.
2. Change the CAB.
cases.expected: Onboard KAVACH shall transit to SB mode. Check for mode on DMI, only after the train is come to standstill.

cases.title: To verify over speed protection in FS Mode, when configured Onboard speed is less than section speed obtained.
cases.input:
1. Configure the Onboard maximum speed value such that it is less than the PSR.
2. Make sure that no faults are present in the system.
3. Cab is active and Onboard is in KAVACH territory and KAVACH, BIU is healthy.
4. Make sure that Onboard is in FS mode and any PSR received and these speeds are greater than the configured Onboard maximum speed.
cases.expected:
1. Brakes should be applied based on Onboard speed, if it is within the range of FSB then FSB is applied or if it is within the range of EB then EB is applied.
2. Check the parameters train speed, permitted speed, target name, target distance, target speed to the Loco Pilot if any on DMI.

cases.title: To verify over speed protection in FS Mode, when configured Onboard speed is less than section speed obtained.
cases.input:
1. Configure the Onboard maximum speed value such that it is less than the TSR.
2. Make sure that no faults are present in the system.
3. Cab is active and Onboard is in KAVACH territory and KAVACH BIU is healthy.
4. Make sure that Onboard is in FS mode and any TSR received but these speeds are more than the configured Onboard maximum speed.

cases.title: To verify normal brake functionality for light engine and formation.
cases.input:
1. Power on the system, make sure that brake test is success.
2. After brake test select the configuration as light engine.
3. Make sure that train is in FS mode.

5. Same steps repeat for formation configuration.
cases.expected: Normal brakes should be applied. This can be verifying by checking the BP value. On DMI, the NB brake symbol can be checked.

cases.title: To verify normal brake functionality For Vande Bharat trains or EMUs or other self-propelled vehicles.
cases.input:
1. Power on the system, make sure that brake test is success.
2. Make sure that train is in FS mode.
3. Now simulate the condition such that normal brakes are applied through KAVACH. To simulate this condition, keep the speed such that, it is more than the MRSP+NSB and less than the MRSP+FSB limit.
4. Same steps repeat for formation configuration.
cases.expected:
1. Normal brakes should not be applied.
2. NB symbol shall not be shown on DMI.
3. If FSB applied, the FSB symbol shall be shown.

cases.title: To verify Full Service brake functionality for light engine and formation.
cases.input:

5. Same steps repeat for formation Configuration.
cases.expected: Full Service brakes should be applied, on DMI the FSB brake symbol can be checked.

cases.title: To verify Emergency brake functionality for light engine and formation.

3. Make sure that train is in FS mode and BIU is healthy.
4. Now simulate the condition such that emergency brakes are applied through KAVACH. To simulate this condition, keep the speed such that, it is more than the MRSP+EB limit.
5. Same steps repeat for formation configuration.
cases.expected: Emergency brakes should be applied; on DMI the EB brake symbol can be checked.

cases.title: To check FS mode to OS mode transition when all conditions are satisfied for home/ starter signal. (FRS 7.5 (a))
cases.input:
1. Power on the system.
2. Make sure that no faults are present.
3. Make sure that train is in FS mode.
4. Now keep the Onboard in standstill
5. FS MA<200mts and Loco Pilot request override option by pressing “OVRD” and “CNFM” buttons.
cases.expected:
1. Override selected is to be shown on DMI.
2. The 6-digit counter should be incremented by one.
3. Check that OSMA is received from stationary KAVACH up to foot of approaching signal irrespective of signal aspect.
4. Signal aspect shall be linked only within 200 meters if there is no KAVACH equipped train.

cases.title: To check FS mode to OS mode transition when all conditions are satisfied for home/ starter signal. (FRS 7.5 (a))
cases.input:
1. Power on the system.
2. Make sure that no faults are present.
3. Make sure that train is in FS mode.
4. Onboard is on run.
5. FS MA<200mts and Loco Pilot request override option by pressing “OVRD” and “CNFM” buttons.
cases.expected: Override shall not be selected.

cases.title: To check FS mode to OS mode transition when all conditions are satisfied for Advanced starter/ IB signal. (FRS 7.5 (a))
cases.input:
1. Power on the system.
2. Make sure that no faults are present.
3. Make sure that train is in FS mode.
4. Keep the Advanced starter stop Signal in ON aspect (RED).
5. Now keep the Onboard in on run.
6. Loco Pilot request override option by pressing “OVRD” and “CNFM” buttons.
cases.expected:
1. Override selected is to be shown on DMI.
2. The 6-digit counter should be incremented by one.
3. Check that OSMA is received from stationary KAVACH as per TOC.
4. Next Signal aspect shall be linked immediately only if there is no KAVACH equipped train within 200 meters, when S-KAVACH to S-KAVACH is not available & loco is registered with approaching Station (next Stn).

cases.title: To check FS mode to OS mode transition when all conditions are satisfied for Advanced starter/ IB signal and linking of approaching signal. (FRS 7.5 (a))
cases.input:

2. Make sure that no faults are present.
3. Make sure that train is in FS mode.
4. Now keep the Onboard in on run.
5. Loco Pilot request override option by pressing “OVRD” and “CNFM” buttons.
6. Another train is available before the approaching stop signal.
cases.expected:
1. Override selected is to be shown on DMI and
2. The 6-digit counter should be incremented by one.
3. Check that OSMA is received from stationary KAVACH up to rear of collision margin.
4. Signal aspect shall not be linked and Onboard shall stop in rear of collision margin.

cases.title: To check FS mode to OV Selected transition when FS MA > 200mts for home/ starter signal. (FRS 7.5 (a))
cases.input:
1. Power on the system.
2. Make sure that no faults are present.
3. Make sure that train is in FS mode.
4. Now keep the Onboard in standstill.
5. MA>200mts and Loco Pilot request override option.
cases.expected:

2. There shall be no increment in OV counter.

cases.title: To check FS mode to OS mode transition when Onboard is in standstill when approaching LSS at danger irrespective of MA. (FRS 7.5 (b))
cases.input:

2. Now keep the Onboard in standstill position.
3. LP request override option.
4. OS MA received from the station.
cases.expected:
1. System shall transit to OS mode with no mode specific speed limit, OV counter should increment by one and the same is to be shown on DMI.
2. The speed limit shall be governed by ‘Authorized Speed’ column of KAVACH TOC.

cases.title: To check FS mode to OS mode transition when Onboard is not in standstill when approaching LSS at danger irrespective of MA. (FRS 7.5 (b))
cases.input:

2. Now keep the Onboard in running position.
3. LP request override option.
4. OS MA received from the station.
cases.expected:
1. System shall transit to OS mode with no mode specific speed limit, OV counter should increment by one and the same is to be shown on DMI.

cases.title: To check FS mode to OS mode transition when Onboard is in standstill when approaching IBS at danger irrespective of MA. (FRS 7.5 (b))
cases.input:
1. Make sure that train is in FS mode.

cases.expected:

cases.title: To check FS mode to OS mode transition when Onboard is not in standstill when approaching IBS at danger irrespective of MA. (FRS 7.5 (b))
cases.input:

cases.title: To check FS mode to OS mode transition when calling on signal is taken off. (FRS 7.5 (c))

cases.title: To check FS mode to OS mode transition when calling on signal is taken off and OSMA not received. (FRS 7.5 (c))

cases.title: To check FS mode to TR mode transition when all conditions are satisfied when signal foot tag is read. (FRS 7.5 (d))

3. Approaching stop signal is in ON aspect and EOA up to signal foot Tag.
4. Simulate the condition such that Onboard crossed after reading Signal Foot (S) tag.
cases.expected:
1. The message “End of Authority in XXXXm shall be display in DMI.
2. Emergency brakes should be applied, TR mode is to be shown on DMI.
3. Trip Counter should increment by one.
4. After selection of PTRIP mode on DMI by the Loco Pilot in standstill condition, system should enter into post trip mode and brake should be release.
5. After override procedure, approaching stop signal shall be linked within 200 meters.

cases.title: To check FS mode to TR mode transition when all conditions are satisfied when signal foot tag is missed. (FRS 7.5 (d))
cases.input:
1. Make sure that train is in FS mode.
2. Keep the approaching Signal at ON.
3. Simulate the condition such that Onboard crossed EOA (MA + 30mts) when Signal Foot (S) tag is missed.
4. SKAVACH sending MA = 0 after passing signal location which will trip immediately when RF communication healthy.
cases.expected:
1. Emergency brakes should be applied, TR mode is to be shown on DMI.
2. Trip Counter should increment by one.
3. After selection of PTRIP mode on DMI is given by the Loco Pilot in standstill condition, system should enter into post trip mode and brake should be release.

cases.title: To check FS mode to RV mode transition when all conditions are satisfied. (FRS 7.5 (e))

3. Make sure that train is in FS mode.
4. Now make sure that the Onboard is in standstill and Loco Pilot requests the reverse mode.
5. Place the handle in reverse direction, w.r.t cab before selecting the RV mode.
cases.expected: RV mode is to be shown on DMI only if loco is in reversing area track condition.

cases.title: To check FS mode to RV mode transition when Onboard is not in standstill. (FRS 7.5 (e))

cases.expected: FS mode is to be shown on DMI.

cases.title: While in FS mode, KAVACH exit tag is detected and Loco Pilot given ACK. (FRS 7.5 (h) (iii), Cond. No. 17)
cases.input:
1. Power on the system.
2. Make sure that no faults are present in the system.
3. Cab is active and Onboard is in KAVACH territory and KAVACH is healthy.
4. Make sure that Onboard is in FS mode.
5. Now simulate the condition such that KAVACH exit tag is detected.
6. The Loco Pilot ACK for this is given within the configurable time period.
cases.expected:
1. System shall remain in FS mode till exit tag. Tag linking will be up to exit tag.
2. The exit tag shall be reported to stationary KAVACH. This shall be checked in NMS log.
3. System should transit to SR mode after reading the exit tag. It can be verified on DMI and ACK request should be there.
4. Position report shall not be erased till the complete train has passed the last TIN (Tag).
5. Onboard will transmit regular packet with last reported TIN till complete train passes exit tag
6. Stationary KAVACH will deregister the Onboard after passage of complete train and Onboard communication shall be stopped without time out.
7. Onboard KAVACH shall stop radio communication after complete passage of train over exit tag.

cases.title: While in FS mode, KAVACH exit tag is detected and Loco Pilot given ACK. MA shall be up to next stop signal/ stop board. (FRS 7.5 (h) (iii), Cond. No. 17)
cases.input:
1. Power on the system.
2. Make sure that no faults are present in the system.
3. Cab is active and Onboard is in KAVACH territory and KAVACH is healthy.
4. Make sure that Onboard is in FS mode.
5. Now simulate the condition such that KAVACH exit tag is detected.
6. Simulate the tag linking up to exit tag.
7. MA shall be up to next stop signal/ stop board.
8. The Loco Pilot ACK for this is given within the configurable time period.
cases.expected:
1. KAVACH should exit from FS mode, brakes should not apply.
2. KAVACH should transit to SR mode, if ACK given by Loco Pilot, brake shall not be applied.
3. The exit tag shall be reported to stationary KAVACH. This shall be checked in NMS log.
4. Position report shall not be erased till the complete train has passed the last TIN (Tag).
5. Onboard will transmit regular packet with last reported TIN till complete train passes exit tag.
6. Stationary KAVACH will deregister the Onboard after passage of complete train and Onboard communication shall be stopped without time out.
7. Onboard KAVACH shall stop radio communication after complete passage of train.

cases.title: While in FS mode, KAVACH exit tag is detected and Loco Pilot not given ACK. (FRS 7.5 (h) (iii), Cond. No. 17)
cases.input:
1. Power on the system.
2. Make sure that no faults are present in the system.
3. Cab is active and Onboard is in KAVACH territory and KAVACH is healthy.
4. Make sure that Onboard is in FS mode.
5. Now simulate the condition such that KAVACH exit tag is detected.
6. The ACK for this is not given within the configurable time period.
cases.expected:
1. Onboard will exit from FS mode, brakes should be applied, traction should be cut off.
2. ACK for SR mode should mention proper displayed massage here display.
3. After ACK timeout (Configurable), brakes should be applied and loco shall continue in SR mode.

cases.title: While in FS mode, KAVACH exit tag is detected and Loco Pilot not given ACK, brake releasing checking. (FRS 7.5 (h) (iii), Cond. No. 17)
cases.input:
1. Power on the system.
2. Make sure that no faults are present in the system.
3. Cab is active and Onboard is in KAVACH territory and KAVACH is healthy.
4. Make sure that Onboard is in FS mode.
5. Now simulate the condition such that KAVACH exit tag is detected.
6. The ACK for this is given after the configurable time period, check the brakes releasing status.
cases.expected:
1. Onboard will exit from FS mode and should enter into SR mode.
2. Message “Ack SR mode, KAVACH Territory Exit” shall be displayed in DMI.
3. Brakes should be applied, traction should be cut off, if no acknowledgement is received within the configurable time,
4. Brakes should not be release until ACK is given.
5. After giving ACK brakes should be released.

cases.title:
To check FS mode to SR mode transition when train traffic direction is unknown. (FRS 7.5 (h) (iv), Cond. No.
30)
cases.input:

2. Now simulate the RFID tag which is programmed in reverse direction absolute location.
3. Now simulate the condition such that the train traffic direction is unknown.
cases.expected:

2. If the Loco pilot gives the ACK within the configurable time, brakes should not apply.

FS mode to SR mode when track profile is not available up to 3000m (configurable) when MA > 3000m (configurable). (FRS 7.5 (h) (i), Cond. No.
23)

cases.title:
FS mode to SR mode when track profile is not available up to MA when MA < 3000m (configurable). (FRS 7.5 (h) (i), Cond. No.

cases.input:

cases.expected:

cases.title:
To check FS mode to SR mode transition when three consecutive linked tags are missed. (FRS 7.5 (h) (ii), Cond. No.
85)

cases.expected:

2. If the Loco pilot gives the ACK within the configurable time, brakes should not apply.

cases.title: To check FS mode to NL mode transition when all conditions are satisfied. (Cond. No. 53)

cases.title: To check FS mode to NL mode transition when Onboard is not in standstill. (Cond. No. 53)
cases.input:

cases.title: To check FS mode to SF mode transition when any critical fault occurred other than radio communication failed. (Cond. No. 5)
cases.input:

2. Make sure that no faults are present.

cases.title: To check FS mode to SF mode transition when one of the redundant modules fail. (Cond. No. 5)
cases.input:
1. Power on the system.
2. Make sure that no faults are present.
3. Make sure that train is in FS mode.

cases.expected: FS mode should continue.
cases.observed: Radio1 Fails Radio-2 fails GPS-1 fails GPS-2 fails Reader1 fails Reader-2 fails CPU fails (In 2 out of 3 system)

cases.input:

2. Make sure that no faults are present.
3. Make sure that train is in FS mode.

3. Make sure that train is in FS mode.

cases.expected: Fault message should be communicated to NMS through GSM module.

cases.title: To check FS mode to SF mode transition when non active cab DMI communication failed. (Cond. No. 5)
cases.input:

2. Make sure that no faults are present.
3. Make sure that train is in FS mode.
4. Now simulate non critical fault, Non-Active CAB communication fail.
cases.expected:

cases.input:

cases.title: To check that system continues in FS mode when train traffic direction is changed while passing over junction tag.
cases.input:
1. Make sure that train is in FS mode.
2. Now simulate the condition such that traffic direction is changed by swiping the junction tag.
cases.expected:

cases.title: To check the Onboard KAVACH mode when direction (reverser made neutral) is removed when Onboard is not at standstill.
cases.input:

2. Keep the Onboard in running and now keep the reverser in neutral position.
cases.expected: Onboard is to be continued in FS mode.

cases.expected: Onboard is to be continued in FS mode.

cases.title: To check the speed warning limit. (Speed beyond permitted speed after which warning is to be displayed on DMI) Default is 2 kmph to be configured
cases.input:
1. Make sure that train is in FS mode from CAB1/CAB2.
2. Keep the Onboard running and simulate the condition such that any MRSP limit is there with respect target distance is in warning zone.
3. Increase the speed beyond permitted speed beyond 2 kmph.
cases.expected:
1. The warning state should be displayed on DMI.
2. The speed limit should be in Light Orange & buzzer should come.
3. Check the warning state, message in data logger.

cases.title: To check that odometer error displayed on DMI while passing signal should not be more than 30 meters at 100kmph & 60 meters at 200 kmph.
cases.input:
1. Power on the system.
2. Make sure that no faults are present.
3. Make sure that train is in FS mode.
4. Simulate such that the Onboard crosses any signal at 100kmph and then 200kmph.
cases.expected:
1. At 100kmph, the absolute location displayed and actual location difference shall be less than 30 meters.
2. At 200kmph, the absolute location displayed and actual location difference shall be less than 60 meters.

cases.title: To check the signal aspect, signal description after crossing the signal and next signal data is available until timeout (8sec). (FRS 24.2 & A2 19.10)
cases.input:
1. System is in FS mode.
2. Radio communication and RFID communication are good.
3. Make sure that system has the data of 2 consecutive signals data.
4. Simulate the condition such that the train crossed the first signal by swiping signal foot tag and Onboard is moving towards next signal observe the signal data on DMI.
5. Next signal data is received before 8 sec.
cases.expected:
1. Signal aspect on LP-OCIP (DMI) shall be changed to aspect of approaching signal.
2. Signal description shall be made blank immediately, when Onboard KAVACH detects that it has crossed the signal on reading the signal foot tag.
3. After crossing the signal, the signal description should be shown < 8sec.

cases.title: To check the signal aspect, signal description after crossing the signal and next signal data is available until timeout occurred and no data is received from Station.
cases.input:
1. System is in FS mode.
2. Radio communication and RFID communication are good.
3. Make sure that system has the data of 2 consecutive signals data.
4. Simulate the condition such that the Onboard crossed just the first signal and Onboard stopped after crossing the signal observe the signal data on DMI.
5. Next signal data is not received from station after 8 sec also.
cases.expected:
1. Until crossing the first signal the signal aspect and description should be shown on DMI of first signal.
2. After crossing the first signal the second signal aspect shall be shown. Signal description shall be made blank (for 8 sec).
3. After 8 sec second signal aspect shall be made blank on DMI.

cases.title: To check the signal aspect, signal description after crossing the signal and next signal data is available until timeout (8sec) passed (signal foot tag is not missed).
cases.input:
1. System is in FS mode.
2. Radio communication and RFID communication are good.
3. Make sure that system has the data of 2 consecutive signals data.
4. Simulate the condition such that the Onboard crossed the first signal by detecting the signal foot tag, and Onboard is moving towards next signal observe the signal data on DMI.
cases.expected: Signal aspect should be updated immediately and signal description should be blank for minimum one cycle and get updated within 8 sec.

cases.title: To check the signal aspect, signal description after crossing the signal and next signal data is available until timeout (8sec) passed (signal foot tag is missed).
cases.input:
1. System is in FS mode.
2. Radio communication and RFID communication are good.
3. Make sure that system has the data of 2 consecutive signals data.
4. Simulate the condition such that the Onboard crossed the first signal by not detecting the signal foot tag, and Onboard is moving towards next signal observe the signal data on DMI.
cases.expected: Signal aspect should be updated within +30 meter after crossing the signal foot tag and signal description should be blank for minimum one cycle and get updated within 8 sec.

cases.title: Switching interval between two radio modems, when both radios are healthy.

3. Make sure that both radio modems are healthy.
cases.expected:
1. Radio modems should switch at interval not exceeding 3 cycles (maximum), for Tx Purpose only.
2. It is verified in NMS log or through dock lite.

cases.title: Simulate radio-1 health fail.
cases.input:

2. Radio communication and RFID communication are good.

cases.expected: There shall not be change in mode. Radio-1 modem fault should be logged and sent to NMS.

cases.title: Simulate radio2 health fail.

cases.title: To check signal aspect when radio communication is failed & Mode transition to LS when Track profile is available. (Absolute Block Section/ Communication Mandatory area) (SRS 5.1)
cases.input:
1. Make sure that Onboard is in FS mode.
2. Simulate radio packets are not receiving.
3. Make sure that Track profile is > 3000 meter is available.
cases.expected:
1. After 6sec the signal aspect and signal description made blank. Mode should be FS mode only.
2. After 30 sec systems should transit to LS mode in absolute block and seek ACK from Loco Pilot.
3. If Ack is not given within 7sec (configurable time) brakes should be applied.

cases.title: Check for FS mode to SF mode transition, when both GPS and RTC fail in Onboard KAVACH.

cases.title: Check for TRACK PROFILE holding verification in FS mode on DMI.
cases.input:
1. Ensure Onboard in FS mode and before home and route is clear till next station home.
2. When Onboard moves beyond home make radio communication fail such that MA is not present.

1. Onboard should transit to LS mode when Radio communication goes bad and continue in LS mode till TRACK PROFILE available is greater than 3000 mtrs. (Use LSS and IB signal separated by 5 Km).

cases.title: Check for MA extension when LSS is at OFF and Line clear is not available in FS mode.
cases.input:
1. When LSS is at ON and Onboard is before LSS check for MA.
2. When LSS is made OFF and Line clear is not available check for MA.

2. When Signal is at OFF and Line clear is available MA should get extended.

cases.title: Check for no mode transition, when the distance and speed correction due to wheel slip happens for less than 90 sec., when cab1 is active and in FS mode. (SRS 3.6.7 (r ))

cases.title: Check for no mode transition, when the distance and speed correction due to wheel slip happens for more than 90 sec., when cab2 is active & in FS mode. (SRS 3.6.7 (r ))

2. If loco pilot ACK, then No brake shall be applied.

cases.title: Check for no mode transition from FS mode when Onboard is standstill for 6 hours.
cases.input:
1. Onboard shall be in FS mode.
2. Onboard shall be in standstill at any location for next 6 hours.
cases.expected: Onboard shall continue in FS mode only.

cases.title: Check for Turn out speed restriction release after whole train crossed the turn out.
cases.input:
1. Onboard is in FS mode.
2. Onboard moving towards any turnout point and route set to respective line.
cases.expected: Loop line speed control (15kmph/ 30 kmph) shall display on DMI until the whole train crossed the turnout point. Message display “TurnOut in XXXXm with Speed Limit YYYkmph”.

cases.title: Check for PSR release after the whole train crossed the PSR limit.
cases.input:
1. Onboard is in FS mode.
2. Onboard is moving towards PSR region.
cases.expected: Message display “PSR in XXXXm with Speed Limit YYYkmph” ”. PSR speed shall be monitored until the whole train crossed the PSR end point.

cases.title: Check for TSR release after the whole train crossed the TSR limit.
cases.input:
1. Onboard is in FS mode.
2. Onboard is moving towards TSR region.
3. Simulate TSR speed 30 kmph for 200 meter, 40 kmph for 300 meter & 75 kmph for 600 meters.
cases.expected:
1. TSR shall display on DMI with speed of 30 kmph, 40 kmph & 75 kmph until the whole train crossed the TSR end point.
2. Message shall be displayed in DMI as “TSR in XXXXm with Speed limit of YYY kmph”.
cases.observed: 30 Kmph/ 200 m 40 Kmph/ 300 m 75 Kmph/ 600 m

cases.title: Check that train runs for 5000km in FS mode.
cases.input:
1. Test to be carried out with loop line of stations.
2. Keep all signals OFF.
3. Routes are set in such a way that some stations are pass the train through loop line and others through Main line.
4. Keep two Onboard at some distance to each other and runs 5000km in a loop of stations.
cases.expected: Train shall be in FS mode only and all Speed supervision message shall be displayed on DMI. Event log shall be cross checked for mode change.

cases.title: Check for brake application, when Coasting is applied at NON zero speed in FS mode.
cases.input:
1. Onboard KAVACH is in FS mode.
2. Loco pilot shut off traction.
3. Neutral is applied.
4. Onboard is moving @100kmph.
cases.expected: KAVACH shall not apply brake and there shall be no change in mode.

cases.title: Check for brake application, when Coasting is applied at Zero speed in FS mode.
cases.input:
1. Onboard KAVACH is in FS mode.
2. When Loco pilot shut off traction.
3. Neutral is applied.
4. Onboard is @ zero kmph.
cases.expected: KAVACH shall not apply brake and there shall be no change in mode.

cases.title: Check for brake application, when Coasting is applied when cab input is not available at non zero speed.
cases.input:
1. Onboard KAVACH is in FS mode.
2. When Loco pilot shut off traction.
3. Ensure that cab input is not available.
4. Onboard is moving @ some speed say 20kmph.
cases.expected: KAVACH shall not apply brake and there shall be no change in mode.

cases.title: Check for brake application, when Coasting is applied at Zero speed and cab input is not available.
cases.input:
1. Onboard KAVACH is in FS mode.
2. When Loco pilot shut off traction.
3. Ensure that cab input is not available.
4. Onboard is @ Zero speed.
cases.expected: KAVACH shall transit to SB mode and supervise standstill protection.

cases.title: Check for no Mode transition from FS mode when train configuration is changed during standstill. (FRS 22.1)
cases.input:
1. Ensure that Onboard is in FS mode.
2. Onboard is at stand still.
3. Make the CAB active.
4. Change the train configuration.
cases.expected:
1. Onboard KAVACH shall conduct. Brake test.
2. On successful brake test Onboard KAVACH should remain in FS mode.

cases.title: Check for dead end approach of Onboard after reading the dead-end Tag.
cases.input:
1. Onboard is in FS mode.
2. Simulate the Onboard movement toward the dead end.
cases.expected:
1. Brake shall be applied in approach of dead end.
2. Message shall be displayed in DMI “Brake Applied, Dead End Detected”

cases.title: Check for dead end approach of Onboard after reading the dead-end Tag.
cases.input:
1. Onboard is in FS mode.
2. Simulate the Onboard movement toward the dead end.
3. Switch OFF the radio and check that system transit to SR mode after time out period.
cases.expected:
1. Brake shall be applied in approach of dead end.
2. Message shall be displayed in DMI “Brake Applied, Dead End Detected”.
3. Check that brake shall not be released after mode transition and both messages along with “Ack SR mode, station Radio comm fail” shall be displayed

cases.title: Check for link failure of TSRMS with stationary KAVACH for time out period (10 & 2 Minute – Configurable).
cases.input:

2. Onboard is moving towards TSR region.
3. Simulate the link failure by removing the TSRMS link.
cases.expected:
1. Onboard shall transit to SR mode after time out.
2. Message shall be displayed in DMI “Ack SR Mode, TSR link Failure.

cases.title: CCheck for display of message “Fouling Mark Entry” when approaching fouling mark zone.
cases.input:
1. Onboard is in FS mode.
2. Simulate the movement of Onboard towards fouling mark zone.
cases.expected:
1. On detection on fouling mark location, the message shall be displayed in DMI as “Fouling Mark Entry” at location point for 6 second.
2. The “Fouling Mark Exit” shall be displayed when message displayed from EOTT (Future).

cases.title: Check for display of message “Braking System Malfunction” when MR pressure below configured value.
cases.input:
1. Onboard is in FS mode.
2. Configure the MR pressure more than 7.5 Kg/cm2.
3. Now simulate the condition that MR pressure dropped below 7.5 i.e. 7 Kg/cm2.
cases.expected:
1. Check for display of message in DMI “Braking System Malfunction”
2. Brake shall be applied till speed become zero.

cases.title: Check for display of message “Ack SR Mode-SR Authorization received” when route is not known.
cases.input:

2. Remove the SKAVACH-to-SKAVACH communication.
3. Stationary KAVACH send SR authorization packet.
cases.expected:
1. Onboard transit to SR mode on receipt of SR authorization.
2. Check for display of message “Ack SR Mode-SR Authorization received”.

cases.title: On detection of Odo error in a frame cycle is more than 120m.
cases.input:
1. Onboard is in FS mode.
2. Simulate the odo error more than 120 meters.
cases.expected:
1. Message shall be displayed in DMI as “Ack for SR Mode-Odo error detected”.
2. Onboard KAVACH shall apply brakes if not acknowledged by loco pilot within time out period.
3. On LP Acknowledge, Onboard transit to SR mode.
4. Position Report shall be removed.

cases.title: Check for display of message “Braking System Malfunction” when BP pressure drop is not within range ie 3.15 to 3.55 Kg/cm2 when FSB is commanded by KAVACH.
cases.input:
1. Onboard is in FS mode.
2. Configure the MR pressure more than 7.5 Kg/cm2.
3. Configure FSB brake build time as 4 second.
4. FSB brake shall be applied and simulate that the BP pressure is increasing more than 3.55 Kg/cm2 within brake build time.
5. FSB brake shall be applied and simulate that the BP pressure is dropping below 3.15 Kg/cm2 within brake build time.
cases.expected:
1. Check for display of message in DMI “Braking System Malfunction” and Onboard transited to SF mode.
2. Brake shall be applied till speed become zero.
1. Check for display of message in DMI “Braking System Malfunction” and Onboard transited to SF mode.
2. Brake shall be applied till speed become zero.

cases.title: Check for display of message “Braking System Malfunction” when BP pressure drop is not within range ie 0.0 to 0.3 Kg/cm2
cases.input:
1. Onboard is in FS mode.
2. Configure the MR pressure more than 7.5 Kg/cm2.
3. Configure EB brake build time as 4 second.
4. EB brake shall be applied and simulate that the BP pressure is dropping and greater than >0.3 Kg/cm2 within brake build time.
cases.expected:
1. Check for display of message in DMI “Braking System Malfunction” and Onboard transited to SF mode.
2. Brake shall be applied till speed become zero.

cases.title: Check for display of message “Braking System Malfunction” when BC pressure is not building within range ie 4.85 to 5.45 Kg/cm2 (For light engine) (When FSB applied)
cases.input:
1. Onboard is in FS mode.
2. Configure the MR pressure more than 7.5 Kg/cm2.

cases.expected:
1. Check for display of message in DMI “Braking System Malfunction” and Onboard transited to SF mode.
2. Brake shall be applied till speed become zero.

cases.title: Check for display of message “Braking System Malfunction” when BC pressure is not building within range ie 4.85 to 5.45 Kg/cm2 (For light engine) (When EB applied)
cases.input:
1. Onboard is in FS mode.

cases.expected:

2. Brake shall be applied till speed become zero.

cases.title: Check for reduction of MA by collision Margin when Onboard Kavach in FS detects another Onboard Kavach in SR with position report and is occupying the same TIN in absolute block section. (Rear End Collision)
cases.input:
1. Ensure Onboard Kavach L1 in FS Mode.
2. Ensure Onboard Kavach L2 in SR Mode with position report and is occupying the berthing track in the route of L1 and has the same direction.
3. Rear end collision is detected by L1 after it enters the occupied TIN.
cases.expected:
1. The FS MA shall reduce by collision margin and train length by Onboard Kavach L1 after occupying the same TIN as of L2.
2. Signal aspect shall not be linked by L1 till L2 crosses the next signal.

cases.title: Check for reduction of MA by collision Margin when Onboard KAVACH in FS detects another Onboard KAVACH in SR with position report and is occupying the same TIN in Auto section. (Rear End Collision)
cases.input:
1. Ensure Onboard KAVACH L1 in FS Mode.
2. Ensure Onboard KAVACH L2 in SR Mode with position report and is occupying the berthing track in the route of L1 and has the same direction.
3. Rear end collision is detected by L1 after it enters the occupied TIN.
cases.expected:
1. The FS MA shall reduce by collision margin and train length by Onboard KAVACH L1 after occupying the same TIN as of L2.
2. Signal aspect shall not be linked by L1 till L2 crosses the next signal.

cases.title: Check for reduction of MA by collision Margin when Onboard Kavach in FS detects another Onboard Kavach in SR with position report and is occupying the same TIN in absolute block section.. (Head On Collision)

cases.title: To verify Rollback protection when Onboard reads RFID Tag.
cases.input:
1. Make sure that the train is in FS mode with forward direction selection.
2. Let the configured rollback distance be 10m.
3. Simulate the condition such that rollback is detected in reverse direction.
4. Simulate RFID tag R-14 read during Rollback.
cases.expected:
1. Brake should not be applied till the configured value of rollout.
2. MA should increase and absolute location should be decremented.
3. Onboard KAVACH remain in FS mode after reading R-14 and subsequent decrement of absolute location.
4. Brakes should be applied after a configurable distance traveled.
5. The message “Rollback Protection, Brake Applied” should be displayed on the DMI and the audio alarm should be operated.
6. Brakes should be released when Onboard comes to a standstill and acknowledged by loco pilot.

2. Rear end collision message “Rear End Collision with Loco XXXXX in YYYY m” and LC gate messages shall be displayed simultaneously in DMI with auto whistling.

cases.title: To check the LC gate operation in FS mode when Head on collision detected.
cases.input:

cases.title:

17)

2. Onboard is on movement.

4. Make sure that OSMA is not extended.
5. On movement, Swipe the exit tag before approaching signal.
cases.expected:
1. System shall remain in FS mode along with Override selected status till exit tag.
2. Tag linking will be up to exit tag.
3. There shall not any spurious braking of this.
4. The exit tag shall be reported to stationary KAVACH. This shall be checked in NMS log.
5. System should transit to SR mode after reading the exit tag. It can be verified on DMI and ACK request should be there.
6. Position report shall not be erased till the complete train has passed the last TIN (Tag).
7. Onboard will transmit regular packet with last reported TIN till complete train passes exit tag.
8. Stationary KAVACH will deregister the Onboard after passes of complete train and Onboard communication shall be stopped without time out.
9. Onboard KAVACH shall stopp radio communication after complete passes of train.
10. If the Loco Pilot gives the ACK within the configurable time, brakes should not apply.
11. If the Loco Pilot didn't give the ACK within the configurable time, brakes should apply.

cases.title: To check OS mode to SR mode transition when Onboard exits from KAVACH territory area. (Cond. No. 17)
cases.input:
1. Make sure that train is in OS mode.
2. Now simulate such that the Onboard read exit tag.
cases.expected:
1. System shall remain in OS mode till exit tag. Tag linking will be up to exit tag. OS MA shall be up to next stop signal. There shall not any spurious braking of this.
2. The exit tag shall be reported to stationary KAVACH. This shall be checked in NMS log.
3. System should transit to SR mode after reading exit tags. It can be verified on DMI and ACK request should be there.
4. Position report shall not be erased till the complete train has passed the last TIN (Tag).
5. Onboard will transmit regular packet with last reported TIN till complete train passes exit tag.
6. Stationary KAVACH will deregister the Onboard after passes of complete train and Onboard communication shall be stopped without time out.
7. Onboard KAVACH shall be stopped radio communication after complete passes of train.
8. If the Loco Pilot give the ACK within the configurable time, brakes should not apply.
9. If the Loco Pilot didn't give the ACK within the configurable time, brakes should apply.

cases.title: To check OS mode to SR mode transition when three consecutive linked tags are missed. (FRS 9.11 (F), Cond. No. 85)
