cases.title: Check for SR mode transition when exit tag is missed beyond the limit of 50m in OS/FS mode.
cases.input:
1. Simulate a scenario where Onboard Kavach at a speed of 100kmph.
2. Ensure track condition of “Kavach territory exit” is received by Onboard Kavach.
3. The exit tag is shifted beyond 50m from its original position.
cases.expected:
• Onboard Kavach shall remain in the current mode till the exit tag location is read or reached. There shall not any spurious braking of this.
• The exit tag shall be reported to stationary KAVACH. This shall be checked in NMS log.
• Onboard Kavach shall transit to SR mode after passes of complete train. It can be verified on DMI and ACK request should be there.
• Position report shall not be erased till the complete train has passed the last TIN (Tag).
• Onboard will transmit regular packet with last reported TIN till complete train passes exit tag.
• Stationary KAVACH will deregister the onboard after passes of complete train and onboard communication shall be stopped without time out.
• Onboard KAVACH shall stop radio communication after complete passes of train.
• If the Loco Pilot presses the ACK within the configurable time, brakes should not apply.
• If the Loco Pilot didn't give the ACK within the configurable time, brakes should apply.

cases.title: To verify successful handing over of a Loco from Station-A to Station-B when the Border Tag is not detected by Loco KAVACH while operating in OS/FS mode and S2S communication is available.
cases.input:
1. Ensure S2S communication link between Station-A (Handing Over Station) and Station-B (Taking Over Station) is healthy.
2. Ensure Border Signal is in OFF condition i.e. G, YY or Y.
3. Simulate Loco movement from Station-A towards Station-B.
4. Station-A shall transmit the Taking Over Station ID to Loco in SORP packet during the handing-over process. (Approaching next stationary KAVACH ID shall be transmitted in SORP from last stop signal in rear of border signal.)
5. Simulate non-reading of Border Tag by Loco KAVACH.
6. Ensure Loco reported front-end location is beyond the Border Tag and within the defined territory limits of Station-B.
7. Verify successful validation of station –B ID received through Access Request packet from Loco.
cases.expected:
1. S2S packet exchange between Handing Over Station (Station-A) and Taking Over Station (Station-B) shall be successful and continuous during the handing-over process.
2. Check in S2S log that Taking Over Station –B shall transmit valid profile information and Movement Authority (MA) as per TOC through RRI packet to station-A.
3. Loco shall update its Station ID to the Taking Over Station ID-B in ARP packet while approaching the Border Signal.
4. Loco shall successfully register with Station-B even though the Border Tag is not detected (Missed).
5. No mode degradation shall happen during the handing-over process.

cases.title: Check for computation of Movement Authority (MA) for five sections.
cases.input:
1. Configure and generate the Stationary KAVACH Application Data for Movement Authority (MA) derivation.
2. Program the generated application data into stationary KAVACH.
3. Simulate a Loco movement in Automatic Block section.
4. Set 6th, 5th ,4th ,3rd, and 2nd Automatic Signal as RED from the loco in route direction the Automatic Signal in Automatic Block Section.
5. Movement of loco in the direction of the route.
cases.expected:
1. Stationary KAVACH should send Movement Authority (MA) based on successive OFF aspects of ahead Automatic Signals.
2. Respective Movement Authority (MA) shall be shown on LP-OCIP.

cases.title: Check repeated override mode function. (If the next signal is at ON, the loco pilot shall press OV and confirm button to override RED aspect Auto signal).
cases.input:
1. Simulate a Loco movement in Automatic Block section and ensure that Loco KAVACH is in FS mode.
2. Set two consecutive automatic signals are in ON state (Red) and simulate a Loco movement towards those signals.
3. Loco KAVACH should stop before the first automatic signal and Override (OV) & confirm button to be selected to pass the Danger Signal (Red).
4. Wait for 02 minute in night and 1 minute in day for receipt of OSMA.
cases.expected:
1. Loco KAVACH should transit to OS mode after receipt of OSMA.
2. Loco KAVACH should pass the second automatic signal in ON SIGHT (OS) mode after receipt of OSMA.

cases.title: Check for On Sight (OS) mode to Full Supervision (FS) mode transition. (If the signal is at OFF and linked, loco shall transit to FS mode after passing stop signal.
cases.input:
1. Simulate a Loco movement in Automatic Block section and ensure that Loco KAVACH is in mode.
2. Set an automatic signal in RED state and simulate a Loco movement towards the signal
3. Loco KAVACH should stop before the signal and Override (OV) selected.
4. Loco should transit to On Sight (OS) mode after receipt of OSMA.
5. Ensure next Automatic signal is in OFF state.
cases.expected:
1. In OS mode, Loco KAVACH should not display Signal aspect and same may be linked within 200 meters from next signal if no onboard is available.
2. Loco KAVACH should transit to FS mode after passing automatic signal.

cases.title: Check for On Sight (OS) to Full Supervision (FS) mode transition in the absence of Signal foot tag.
cases.input:
1. Simulate a Loco movement in Automatic Block section and ensure that Loco KAVACH is in OS mode.
2. Set an automatic signal in OFF state and simulate a Loco movement towards the signal.
3. Simulate the onboard movement and make sure that signal foot tag is not read by onboard (signal foot tag is Missed).
cases.expected: Loco KAVACH should transit to FS mode after passing the signal Location +30 meter.

cases.title: Check for extending MA, when one Loco is ahead of other Loco.
cases.input:
1. Simulate a Loco movement in Automatic Block Section and ensure that Loco is in FS mode.
2. Simulate a second Loco movement in rear of first Loco.
3. Second Loco should stop Rear stop signal of first Loco, Override (OV) mode to be selected to enter first Loco occupied section.
4. Ensure first Loco is before 10m from the automatic signal and signal is in OFF state
5. Simulate second Loco movement towards first Loco.
6. Clear an Automatic signal/ Semi-Automatic Signal for first Loco.
7. Clear an Automatic signal/Semi-Automatic Signal for second Loco, after passing the first Loco.
cases.expected:
1. Second Loco should enter into On Sight (OS) mode after receipt of OSMA.
2. Rear end collision message shall be displayed on second Loco LP-OCIP.
3. Brakes shall be applied and it should stop before 300m from the first Loco.
4. Signal Aspect should not be shown in LP-OCIP (2nd loco).
5. Stationary KAVACH extend MA for First Loco and shall not extend MA for second Loco.
6. Stationary KAVACH shall extend MA for Second Loco, after movement of first loco.
7. Signal Aspect shall be linked within 200 meters from the signal if the 1st onboard crossed the signal.

cases.title: Check KAVACH functionality for Semiautomatic Signal with Calling-On.
cases.input:
1. Simulate a Loco movement in Automatic Block section and ensure that Loco is in FS mode.
2. Stop the loco before Semi-automatic signal with A marker not lit.
3. Set a semi-automatic signal at ON and its calling-on signal at OFF.
4. Simulate Loco movement towards the signal.
5. Section Speed is less than the Calling on Signal speed restriction (Section speed is 10kmph, Calling-on speed restriction is 15kmph).
cases.expected:

cases.title: Check for Position Report Correction when Location Correction details and Tag Linking information is not available. (A-Tag is read with valid position report) (Use Cases)

3. Check communication is not available with Stationary KAVACH and LVK is in SR mode.
4. Check valid position report is available with LVK before passing A-Tag.

cases.expected:
1. When the LVK reads the A Tag, at least one of the two programmed locations in the A Tag shall fall within the expected tolerance window of ±50 m with respect to the travelled distance from the last reference RFID Tag location (say R2).
2. A-Tag expected location window from previous Tag location (1120m) and traveled distance of D m when A-Tag is read in Nominal direction from R2 Tag will be (1120 + D–50) m to (1120+ D+50) m. Current TIN of Loco is N90. Current direction of Loco is Nominal. These values will match with one of the programmed location correction details in the A-tag.
3. In this case, the set of programmed values matches with current values are 1150 location, Nominal → Nominal direction correction and N90 TIN in A-Tag.
4. The other set of values programmed in A-Tag are 11000m location, Reverse → Reverse direction correction and N91 TIN.
5. As Location changes from 1150 to 11000m, LVK shall change its new location to 11000m.
6. As direction changes from Nominal → Nominal, LVK shall change its new direction as Nominal.
7. As TIN changes from N90 to N91 in A-Tag, LVK shall change its new TIN as N91
8. Position Report correction after reading A-Tag shall be:

Current TIN of Loco is N91. Current direction of Loco is Nominal.

cases.title: To verify sub profile packets transmission in RRI packets. (P2.2.2)
cases.input:
1. Ensure S2S communication is healthy between Station A & Station B.
2. Register loco in Station A in FS/OS mode.
3. Border Signal shall be at Off and its next signal at ON.
4. Station A shall request MA sections as per Toc.
5. Check for profile transmission in RRI packet.
6. Now Take off all the signals in Station B.
7. Station A shall request MA sections as per Toc.
8. Check for profile transmission in RRI packet.
cases.expected:
1. Verify that in first handover packet, Station A shall send profile ID as 0.
2. After the reception of Profiles from Station B in RRI packet, Station A shall update the profile ID with same as the profile ID received in RRI packet from Station B.
3. Sub profile packets (track profile info) shall not be transmitted by Station B in RRI packet, after Prof Id received in handover packet is same as the Prof Id transmitted in RRI packet. Loco shall remain in existing mode.
4. Sub profile packets (track profile info) shall be transmitted continuously by Station B in RRI packet, If Ref Prof Id in RRI is not updated in Stn Prof Id in Handover packet. Loco shall remain in existing mode.

cases.title: To verify the PDI check and PDI version packets when S2S communication between Station A & Station B is restarted. (P3.1.3)
cases.input:
1. Ensure S2S communication is healthy between Station A & Station B.
2. Disconnect the S2S communication link in Station A and reconnect after 10secs.
3. Observe the PDI check and PDI version packets in the log.
cases.expected:
1. Check Adjacent S-KAVACH Link-1 and Link-2 fail on SM-OCIP and in NMS after link disconnection.
2. Check Adjacent S-KAVACH Link-1 and Link-2 recovery on SM-OCIP and in NMS after link restoration.
3. Verify the PDI check packet and PDI version packets with change in random number in S2S logs after restarting of S2S communication.
4. Heartbeat packets exchange shall be started and observed in the log.

cases.title: To verify the Taken over packet from Station B to Station A when loco is registered with Station B. (P2.2.4)
cases.input:
1. Ensure S2S communication is healthy between Station A & Station B.
2. Keep all the signals in Station A & Station B at OFF.
3. Register a loco with Station A & move towards border signal in FS/OS mode and read the border tag of Station B.
cases.expected:
1. Loco shall register with Station B after reading border tag.
2. Verify the Taken Over packet shall be transmitted by Station B to Station A in S2S.
3. After receiving the Taken Over packet, Station A shall not transmit any further Handover packets and de-register if there is no TLM data exchange.

cases.title: To verify the HandOver Cancellation and HandOver Cancellation Ack packets. (P2.2.6)
cases.input:
1. Ensure S2S communication is healthy between Station A & Station B.
2. Keep all the signals at OFF and Loco is registered with Station A in FS/OS mode.
3. Now, put-back the signals in Station A.
cases.expected:
1. Verify the Hand Over and RRI packet exchange in S2S between Station A & Station B when S2S is healthy.
2. After the signals are put-back, RED signal aspect shall be displayed on DMI and MA shall be up to ahead signal.
3. Verify the Handover Cancellation packet transmission from Station A to Station B in S2S log.
4. After receiving the Handover Cancellation packet, Handover Cancellation Ack packet shall be transmitted by Station B to Station A in S2S log.
5. Verify there shall be no Handover and RRI packet exchange between Station A & Station B.

cases.title: To verify the TLM packet exchange in S2S between Station A & Station B. TLM computation shall be completed in Station A. (P2.2.5)
cases.input:
1. Enable TLM sharing between Station A & Station B in Station A application data.
2. Ensure S2S communication is healthy between Station A & Station B.
3. Keep all the signals in Station A & Station B at OFF.
4. Register a loco with Station A & move towards border signal in FS/OS mode.
5. Move the loco and read the border tag of Station B and register with Station B.
cases.expected:
1. Verify that TLM start shall be transmitted by Station A to Loco.
2. Verify that TLM Info packet from Station A to Station B is transmitted if the Loco doesn't acknowledge the TLM info transmitted in SORP for 5 consecutive cycles.
3. Verify that TLM Ack packet is transmitted from Station B to Station A giving Ack for start packet.
4. Verify that TLM end info shall be transmitted by Station A to Loco.
5. .
6. After Loco registers with Station B, it shall transmit the TLM start & end info (received through S2S from Station A) in SORP to Loco.
7. The DMI shall display the message “TLM Computation is in progress” while the TLM computation is being executed.
8. Upon successful completion of the TLM computation, the DMI shall display the message “TLM Computation Success”.

cases.title: To verify the FES Request & FES Response packet exchange in S2S when FES sharing (Relays, TINs, Virtual Signals) is available between Station A & Station B.
cases.input:
1. Configure FES relay contacts sharing between Station A & Station B in both Stations application data.
2. Ensure S2S communication is healthy between Station A & Station B.
3. Now observe the FES Request & FES Response packets in Station A S2S log.
cases.expected:
1. Observe FES request packet from Station A to Station B in NMS.
2. Observe the FES response packet from Station B to Station A in reply to the FES request packet having status of Relay contacts in NMS. 1 – Relay contact/TIN is in picked /occupied state 0 - Relay contact/TIN is in dropped/ free state.

cases.title: To check for mode transition when loco failed to register with Station B until loco tail crosses border RFID tag.
cases.input:
1. Ensure S2S communication is healthy between Station A & Station B.
2. Set the train type selection to Formation.
3. Simulate loco movement from Station A to Station B in FS mode and entered Station B
cases.expected:
1. Loco shall continue to communicate with Station A and shall stay in FS mode until the complete train has crossed the border RFID tag location or reports a tag beyond border tag.
2. Tag missing indication shall be displayed on DMI for the border RFID tag.

cases.title: To check for change in MA sections during run time override of Adv str signal in S2S communication when the adjacent Station IB stop signal is transitions from ON to OFF
cases.input:
1. Ensure S2S communication is healthy between Station A to Station C.
2. Keep Adv. Str signal of Station A to Red and IB stop signal of Station B to Red.
3. Select runtime override in loco before Adv. Str signal of Station A
4. Again, select runtime override in loco immediately after crossing Adv. Str signal within Station A limits.
5. Now, change IB stop signal from Red to Green.
cases.expected:
1. OS MA shall be extended up to IB stop signal after selecting run time OVRD on approach of Adv. Str signal.
2. OS MA shall be extended up to Station C stop signal when runtime OVRD is selected immediately after crossing Adv. Str signal within Station A limits.
3. Check that OS MA shall be displayed up to Station C stop signal and there shall be no sudden drop in MA when the IB stop signal aspect is changed from Red to Green.
4. Green signal aspect shall be linked on DMI in OS mode.

cases.title: Check for linking of permissive signals when permissive signal is made as border and OVRD is selected on approach of LSS. S-KAVACH to S-KAVACH communication is available
cases.input:
1. Loco is in FS mode and approaching towards Adv. Str S1 at Red
2. When loco is in movement, press OV and CNFM button on DMI.
3. Allow loco to cross S2 D border RFID tag.
4. Check for linking of permissive signals on DMI.
cases.expected:
1. Onboard KAVACH shall display ‘Override Selected’.
2. The Onboard KAVACH should transit to OS mode on receipt of OSMA.
3. The OS speed shall be authorized speed and MA section as per KAVACH TOC.
4. Permissive signal S2 D shall not be linked on DMI.
5. After reading permissive signal S2 D border RFID tag and registering with Station B, next approaching permissive signal S2 ID aspect shall be displayed on DMI

cases.title: Check for linking of permissive signals when permissive signal is made as border and OVRD is selected on approach of IB signal. S-KAVACH to S-KAVACH communication is available
cases.input:
1. Loco is in FS mode and approaching towards IB distant signal S2 and IB stop signal S2 is set to Red.
2. When loco is in movement, press OV and CNFM button on DMI.
3. Allow loco to cross S3 ID border RFID tag.
4. Check for linking of permissive signals on DMI.
cases.expected:
1. Onboard KAVACH shall display ‘Override Selected’.
2. The Onboard KAVACH should transit to OS mode on receipt of OSMA.
3. The OS speed shall be authorized speed and MA section as per KAVACH TOC.
4. Permissive signal , S3D, shall not be linked on DMI.
5. After reading permissive signal S3ID border RFID tag & registering with Station C, next approaching stop signal aspect shall be linked on DMI

cases.title: Check for holding of SOS speed when loco is moving from Station A to Station B during RF comm failure S2S communication is mandatory between Station A to Station B.
cases.input:
1. Make sure loco is registered with Station A in FS/OS mode.
2. Generate Manual SOS from Station A when the Onboard is within 3km from Station center location.
3. Create RF comm failure in Station A by removing COM ports to both radios.
4. Check for SOS speed holding when Onboard registers with Station B.
5. Restore RF comm in Station A & cancel manual SOS in Station A within 180 sec after registering with Station B
cases.expected:
1. SOS from Station message shall be displayed on LP-OCIP.
2. FSB shall be applied & the Onboard shall reach to standstill.
3. After reaching to ‘0’ kmph, the Onboard speed shall be supervised for SOS speed limit 30 kmph.
4. Loco shall transit to LS/SR modes after communication timeout and supervise for SOS speed limit 30 kmph.
5. Loco shall register with Station B and speed shall be supervised for SOS speed limit of 30 kmph in FS/OS mode till SOS timeout of 180 sec.
6. Loco speed shall be restored to maximum section speed after clearing of manual SOS.

cases.title: Check for holding of SOS speed when loco is moving from Station A to Station B when S2S communication is mandatory between Station A to Station B.
cases.input:
1. Make sure loco is registered with Station A in FS/OS mode.
2. Generate Manual SOS from Station A when the Onboard is within 3km from Station center location.
3. Remove S2S Communication between Station A & Station B, Station A shall issue SR Authority to Loco.
4. Onboard shall register with Station B within SOS timeout of 180 sec.
cases.expected:
1. SOS from Station message shall be displayed on LP-OCIP.
2. FSB shall be applied & the Onboard shall reach to standstill.
3. After reaching to ‘0’ kmph, the Onboard speed shall be supervised for SOS speed limit 30 kmph even in SR mode.
4. Loco shall register with Station B and speed shall be supervised for SOS speed limit 30 kmph in OS mode till SOS timeout of 180 sec.

cases.title: To check for simultaneous Hand Over & RRI packet exchange between adjacent Stations with 4 lines (2 lines shall be designed with absolute sections & other 2 lines shall be designed with automatic sections) S2S communication is required between Station A to Station C.
cases.input:
1. Make sure S2S communication is healthy between Station A, Station B & Station C.
2. Register four locos with Station B in FS mode:
2.1. Two locos shall be registered in absolute block section in two different lines in Nominal direction.
2.2. The other two locos shall be registered in automatic section in two different lines in Reverse direction.
3. Check for Handover & RRI packet exchange.
4. Set the route to line clear upto the Border signals of the adjacent Stations.
5. Check for Handover & RRI packet exchange status in logs
6. Keep the last stop signals of Station B to Red in all the four lines.
7. Check for Handover, RRI, Handover Cancellation & Handover Cancellation Ack packet status in logs
8. Set the route to line clear beyond Border signals of the adjacent Stations
9. Allow the locos to cross border signal and register with adjacent Stations.
cases.expected:
1. Verify the Hand Over and RRI packet exchange in S2S between Station A, Station B & Station C when S2S is healthy.
2. Handover Cancellation & Handover Cancellation Ack packets shall be transmitted to all the 4 locos when last stop signals of Station B is set to Red.
3. Handover & RRI packets shall be exchanged for all the 4 locos simultaneously when the route is set to line clear and loco shall continue in FS mode.
4. Check the NMS for all the S2S packets exchanged for 4 locos.

cases.title: To check for Handover cancellation packets between Station A to Station C when MA sections are not required beyond border signal
cases.input:
1. Ensure S2S communication is healthy between Station A to Station C.
2. Route is set to line clear beyond the Border signal of Station C(between Station B & Station C).
3. Loco is registered with Station A in FS mode.
4. Station A shall request MA sections beyond the Border signal of Station C (between Station B & Station C).
5. Keep last stop signal in Station A to Red and check for Handover Cancellation packets between Station A to Station B & Station B to Station C.
cases.expected:
Verify the Hand Over and RRI packet exchange in S2S between Station A, Station B & Station C when S2S is healthy.
1. Verify the transmission of Handover Cancellation packets between Station A to Station B & Station B to Station C in NMS.
2. After receiving the Handover Cancellation packet, Handover Cancellation Ack packet shall be transmitted by Station C to Station B and Handover Cancellation Ack packet shall be transmitted by Station B to Station A.
3. Verify in NMS, there shall be no Handover and RRI packet exchange between Station A, Station B & Station C.

cases.title: To check for transmission of Handover packet & Handover Cancellation packets exchange when the ahead loco-2 was registered lately with Station & after the rear loco-1 was registered with the Station. S2S communication is required between Station A to Station B
cases.input:
1. Make sure S2S communication is healthy between Station A to Station B.
2. Register Loco-1 in FS mode before the advance starter signal in Station
A.
3. Route is set to line clear beyond border signal of Station B.
4. Check for Handover & RRI packet exchange between Station A & Station B for Loco-1.
5. Register Loco-2 after the advance starter signal.
6. Check for Handover Cancellation & Ack packets exchange between Station A & Station B for Loco-1.
7. Check for Handover & RRI packet exchange between Station A & Station B for Loco-2.
cases.expected:
4. Verify in log that Handover & RRI packet exchange shall happen only for Loco-1 between Station A & Station B.
5. After the loco-2 is registered, check for rear end SOS for Loco-1 and MA is truncated up to the Collision margin.
6. Verify in log that for Handover Cancellation & Ack packets exchange shall happen only for Loco-1 between Station A & Station B.
7. Verify in log that Handover & RRI packet exchange shall happen only for Loco-2 between Station A & Station B.

cases.title: Check for Rear End collision when loco-1 is registered in Station C and loco-2 is registered in Station A and are moving in Nominal direction. S2S communication is required between Station A, Station B & Station C
cases.input:
1. Make sure S2S communication is healthy between Station A, Station B & Station C.
2. Loco-1 is in FS mode at standstill and registered with Station C before Home signal in block section..
3. Loco-2 is moving in FS mode and registered with Station A after the advance starter signal.
4. Route is set to Line clear from Station A to Station C.
cases.expected:
1. Rear End SOS message shall be displayed in Loco-2.
2. MA in Loco-2 shall be displayed up to rear of Loco-1 train length with additional Rear End margin distance of 300 mts (configurable).
3. Brake shall be applied in rear Loco-2 if it is within collision margin.
4. Signal aspect shall not be linked on DMI in Loco-2.
5. Rear end collision with Loco-1 message shall be displayed in Loco-2 when distance between both loco are less than 5000 mts (configurable)

cases.title: Check for Head On collision when loco-1 is registered in Station C and loco-2 is registered in Station A and are approaching head on. S2S communication is required between Station A, Station B & Station C
cases.input:
1. Make sure S2S communication is healthy between Station A, Station B & Station C.
2. Loco-1 is moving in SR and registered with Station C in block section.
3. Loco-2 is moving in FS mode and registered with Station A after the advance starter signal.
4. Route is set to Line clear from Station A to Station C.
cases.expected:
1. Head On SOS message shall be displayed on L-1 & L-2
2. Signal aspects & MA shall not be displayed in L-1 & L-2
3. Brakes shall be applied in both the locos.

cases.title: To verify the MA and profile transmissions when the Border Signal between Station A and Station B is in Calling-on aspect and S2S Communication is mandatory between Station A and Station B
cases.input:
1. Ensure S2S communication is healthy between Station A & Station B.
2. Simulate loco movement from Station A to Station B.
3. Stop the Loco before the border signal in FS mode and set the route with border signal as calling-on aspect.
4. Station A shall request MA sections as per Toc in Ho Req.
5. Check for Calling-on aspect and the MA as per TOC on DMI
cases.expected:
1. Loco shall transit to OS mode and Calling-on signal aspect & MA shall be displayed on DMI.
2. MA will be displayed as per Toc.
3. After crossing the Calling-on signal foot tag, next signal aspect shall not be displayed on DMI.
4. Approaching signal aspect shall be linked when loco is within 200 mts from the signal.

cases.title: Check for display of Station ID, KMS key index, TSR count and System health status on SM-OCIP
cases.input:
1. Power ON S-KAVACH.
2. Make sure application data files are loaded in S-KAVACH
3. Ensure valid KMS keys are available in S-KAVACH
4. Check for System health status on SM-OCIP
cases.expected: Line-1 shall display the “ID:33064 KI:XX T:YY” where XX is Key Index value shall be shown between 1 to 30 and not ‘0’ & YY is number of TSRs available in station Line-2 shall display current date and time as “DD-MM-YY: “HR:MM:SS” Line-4 shall display “STN KAVACH OK” Note: Key Index value shall be shown between 1 to 30 and not ‘0’.

cases.title: Check for display of S-KAVACH system status message on SM-OCIP.
cases.input:
1. Make sure S-KAVACH is healthy
2. Ensure valid KMS keys are available in S-KAVACH
3. Check for System health status on SM-OCIP.
4. Fail both the radios in S-KAVACH and check for System health status on SM-OCIP.

cases.title: Check for display of S-KAVACH executive software checksums and configuration files checksums on SM-OCIP.
cases.input:

2. Press COMMON button for 10 sec on SM-OCIP
3. Check for display of checksums on SM-OCIP.
cases.expected: Station executive software and configuration files checksums shall be displayed on SM-OCIP, and all the checksums shall be cleared after 1 minute.

cases.title: Check for Generation and Cancellation of Manual SOS from SM-OCIP
cases.input:
1. Make sure SM-KEY is in ON state
2. Generate manual SOS by pressing SOS + COMMON push buttons simultaneous on SM-OCIP.
3. Check SOS message & led status on SM-OCIP
1. Cancel manual SOS by pressing CANCEL + COMMON push buttons simultaneous on SM-OCIP.
2. Check SOS message & led status on SM-OCIP

2. SOS led shall be LIT in Red color & audio buzzer shall be activated until SOS is cancelled.

4. Date & Time shall not be displayed till manual SOS is cancelled on SM-OCIP
1. “SOS CANCELLED” message shall be displayed in Line-3 for 30 sec.
2. SOS led shall not be LIT. It shall be in OFF state & audio buzzer shall stop.

cases.title: Check for display of SOS reception message on SM-OCIP when manual SOS is generated from Onboard KAVACH.

2. SOS led shall be LIT in Red color & audio buzzer shall be activated until SOS is cancelled.

cases.title: Check for manual SOS and display of checksums when SM-Key is placed in OFF position or removed.

2. Press COMMON push button on SM-OCIP for 10 sec.
3. Generate SOS by pressing SOS + COMMON push buttons simultaneous on SM-OCIP.

cases.input:

cases.expected:
1. “SOS GENERATED” message shall be displayed in Line-2

cases.purpose:
This test is to verify that the UHF radio modems support full-duplex operations simultaneously in all 68 timeslots of width
22.5ms (432 bits or 54 bytes) and spaced 5ms (96 bits or 12 bytes) apart.
cases.methodology:
1. One UHF radio modem shall be connected to Station Simulator.
2. One UHF radio modem shall be connected to Onboard Simulator.
3. The Station shall be permanently tuned to transmit a f frequency (pair 1 / 8) and Onboard shall be permanently tuned sx to receive on the same frequency.
4. The Onboard shall be permanently tuned to transmit a f frequency (pair 1 / 8) and Station shall be permanently tuned mx to receive on the same frequency.
5. The arrangement shall be as shown in the figure.
6. The following counters shall be maintained on each side and logged:
6.a. Number of Packets transmitted.
6.b. Number of bytes transmitted.
6.c. Number of Packets received.
6.d. Number of valid packets received.
6.e. Number of bytes received.
6.f. Number of valid bytes received.
cases.input:
i. The PKT_TYPE shall be set to 0x1001 (Stn2Onboard Regular Pkt). [O]
ii. PKT_LENGTH shall be set to 34 bytes. [M]
iii. FRAME_NUM field shall be set as per the normal calculations (based on the PC). [O]
iv. DESTN_ONBOARD_ID shall be set to 666666. [O]
v. The rest of the fields shall be set to random values except for CRC. [O]
vi. The data is to be buffered to Radio Modem in the guard band and RTS to be made high2ms before the end of guard band. RTS shall be made low after the entire buffering is completed. [S]
cases.expected:
i. The PKT_TYPE shall be set to 0x1010 (Onboard2Stn Regular Pkt). [O]
ii. PKT_LENGTH shall be set to 29 bytes. [M]
iii. FRAME_NUM field shall be set as per the normal calculations (based on the PC). [O]
iv. DEST-STN_IBS_LC_ID shall be set to 44444. [O]
v. The rest of the fields shall be set to random values except for CRC. [O]
vi. The data is to be buffered to Radio Modem in the guard band and RTS to be made high 2ms before the end of guard band. RTS shall be made low after the entire buffering is completed. [S]
cases.result: The Bit Error Rate shall be less than 10-6 and all the data in 68 time slots shall be received without fail.

cases.expected_label: Transmission of packets from Onboard side

cases.title: Testing for TRACKCOND_CNT by Onboard KAVACH (TRACK CONDITION INFORMATION)
cases.purpose: This test is to verify the Onboard KAVACH processes TRACKCOND_CNT properly.
cases.methodology:
1. The setup as shown in figure 3 shall be set up, except of adding channel attenuators in the reception antenna. y 2. The following counters shall be maintained on each side and logged:
2.a. Number of Packets transmitted.
2.b. Number of bytes transmitted.
2.c. Number of Packets received.
2.d. Number of valid packets received.
2.e. Number of bytes received.
2.f. Number of valid bytes received.

cases.input:
Stationary KAVACH should send a packet with PKT_TYPE as 0110 followed by complete packet and valid packet length (SUB_PKT_ LENGTH).
| TRACKCOND_CNT | SUB_PKT_LENGTH |
| 1 | 6 |
| 2 | 10 |
| 3 | 14 |
| 6 | 27 |
| 10 | 44 |
| 13 | 57 |
| 15 | 65 |
cases.expected: The Onboard KAVACH should process the packet. The Onboard KAVACH shall decode the packets and TRACKCOND_TYPE, START-DIST-TRACKCOND and LENGTH_TRACKCOND shall be same as the ones sent by station and the same shall be recorded for these cases. The Onboard KAVACH shall ignore all the track conditions for which it has already passed.
cases.result: The Onboard KAVACH should receive the packet and shall be available in the log. The Onboard KAVACH should not process the unintended packets.
cases.input_label: Transmission of packets from Station side
cases.expected_label: Reception of packets at Onboard side

cases.input: The Stationary KAVACH shall send TRACKCOND_CNT as “0”.
cases.expected: The Onboard KAVACH shall process the packet and there are no Track conditions in the route.
cases.input_label: Transmission of packets from Station side
cases.expected_label: Reception of packets at Onboard side

cases.title: Testing for TRACKCOND_TYPE by Onboard KAVACH (TRACK CONDITION INFORMATION)
cases.purpose: This test is to verify the Onboard KAVACH processes TRACKCOND_TYPE properly.
cases.methodology:
1. The setup as shown in figure 3 shall be set up, except of adding channel attenuators in the reception antenna. y 2. The following counters shall be maintained on each side and logged:
2.a. Number of Packets transmitted.
2.b. Number of bytes transmitted.
2.c. Number of Packets received.
2.d. Number of valid packets received.
2.e. Number of bytes received.
2.f. Number of valid bytes received.

cases.input: Stationary KAVACH should send a packet with PKT_TYPE as 0110 followed by complete packet and valid packet length (SUB_PKT_ LENGTH) and TRACKCOND_COUNT as 1. The Stationary KAVACH shall send TRACKCOND_TYPE as “0000”.
cases.expected: 1. The Onboard KAVACH should process the packet. The Onboard KAVACH shall decode the packets and TRACKCOND_TYPE, START-DIST-TRACKCOND and LENGTH_TRACKCOND shall be same as the ones sent by station and the same shall be recorded for these cases. The Onboard KAVACH shall not process the packet further.
cases.result: The Onboard KAVACH should receive the packet and shall be available in the log. The Onboard KAVACH should not

cases.expected_label: Reception of packets at Onboard side

cases.input: Stationary KAVACH should send a packet with PKT_TYPE as 0110 followed by complete packet and valid packet length (SUB_PKT_ LENGTH) and TRACKCOND_COUNT as 8. The Stationary KAVACH shall send as first TRACKCOND_TYPE as Dead Stop “0001” and START-DIST-TRACKCOND within Movement Authority and LENGTH_TRACKCOND as xx m. (Generally 0m)
cases.expected:
The Onboard KAVACH should process the packet. The Onboard KAVACH shall decode the packets as follows
(i) TRACKCOND_TYPE as dead stop. It shall display “Approaching Dead Stop in XXXX m” on DMI.
(ii) START-DIST-TRACKCOND shall be used for deducing End of Authority.
(iii)LENGTH_TRACKCOND shall not be considered in this case. Default -Binary 111 1111 1111 1111 can be sent.
cases.result: process the unintended packets
cases.input_label: Transmission of packets from Station side
cases.expected_label: Reception of packets at Onboard side

cases.input: Stationary KAVACH should send a packet with PKT_TYPE as 0110 followed by complete packet and valid packet length (SUB_PKT_ LENGTH) and TRACKCOND_COUNT as 8. The Stationary KAVACH shall send as Second TRACKCOND_TYPE as Radio Hole “0010” and START-DIST-TRACKCOND within Movement Authority and LENGTH_TRACKCOND as xx m (Generally ≤ 100m).
